questions.question: যদি $\tan \beta=4 \cot \alpha$ হয় তবে দেখাও যে, $\frac{\cos (\alpha+\beta)}{\cos (\alpha-\beta)}=-\frac{3}{5}$.
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $\tan \beta=4 \cot \alpha$

 

বা, $\frac{\tan \beta}{\cot \alpha}=4$

 

বা, $\tan \alpha \tan \beta=4\left[\because \frac{1}{\cot \alpha}=\tan \alpha\right]$

 

বা, $\frac{2 \sin \alpha \sin \beta}{2 \cos \alpha \cos \beta}=4\left[\because \tan \theta=\frac{\sin \theta}{\cos \theta}\right]$

 

বা, $\frac{\cos (\alpha-\beta)-\cos (\alpha+\beta)}{\cos (\alpha+\beta)+\cos (\alpha-\beta)}=4$

 

বা, $\frac{\cos (\alpha-\beta)-\cos (\alpha+\beta)+\cos (\alpha+\beta)+\cos (\alpha-\beta)}{\cos (\alpha-\beta)-\cos (\alpha+\beta)-\cos (\alpha+\beta)-\cos (\alpha-\beta)}=\frac{4+1}{4-1}$

[যোজন-বিয়োজন করে]

বা, $\frac{2 \cos (\alpha-\beta)}{-2 \cos (\alpha+\beta)}=\frac{5}{3}$


বা, $\frac{-\cos (\alpha+\beta)}{\cos (\alpha-\beta)}=\frac{3}{5}$


$\therefore \frac{\cos (\alpha+\beta)}{\cos (\alpha-\beta)}=-\frac{3}{5}$. (দেখানো হলো)

questions.question: দেখাও যে, $\sin (B+C-A)+\sin (C+A-B) +$ $\sin (A+B-C)=\frac{32 \Delta^3}{a^2 b^2 c^2}$.
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $\mathrm{S}=\frac{\mathrm{a}+\mathrm{b}+\mathrm{c}}{2}$ এবং $\Delta=\mathrm{ABC}$ এর ক্ষেত্রফল

$ \Delta \mathrm{ABC}-\Omega, \mathrm{A}+\mathrm{B}+\mathrm{C}=\pi$

বামপক্ষ $= \sin (\mathrm{B}+\mathrm{C}-\mathrm{A})+\sin (\mathrm{C}+\mathrm{A}-\mathrm{B})+\sin (\mathrm{A}+\mathrm{B}-\mathrm{C}) $

$= \sin (\pi-\mathrm{A}-\mathrm{A})+\sin (\pi-\mathrm{B}-\mathrm{B})+\sin (\pi-\mathrm{C}-\mathrm{C}) $

$ {[\because \mathrm{A}+\mathrm{B}+\mathrm{C}=\pi] } $

$= \sin (\pi-2 \mathrm{~A})+\sin (\pi-2 \mathrm{~B})+\sin (\pi-2 \mathrm{C}) $

$= \sin 2 \mathrm{~A}+\sin 2 \mathrm{~B}+\sin 2 \mathrm{C} $

$= 2 \sin (\mathrm{~A}+\mathrm{B}) \cos (\mathrm{A}-\mathrm{B})+\sin 2 \mathrm{C} $

$= 2 \sin (\pi-\mathrm{C}) \cos (\mathrm{A}-\mathrm{B})+\sin 2 \mathrm{C}[\because \mathrm{~A}+\mathrm{B}+\mathrm{C}=\pi] $

$= 2 \sin \mathrm{C} \cos (\mathrm{~A}-\mathrm{B})+2 \sin \mathrm{C} \cos \mathrm{C} $

$= 2 \sin \mathrm{C}[\cos (\mathrm{~A}-\mathrm{B})+\cos \mathrm{C}] $

$= 2 \sin C[\cos (A-B)+\cos \{\pi-(A+B)\}][\because A+B+C=\pi] $

$= 2 \sin C[\cos (A-B)-\cos (A+B)] $

$= 2 \sin C \cdot 2 \sin A \sin B=4 \sin A \sin B \sin C $

$= 4 \times \frac{2 \Delta}{b c} \times \frac{2 \Delta}{c a} \times \frac{2 \Delta}{a b}$

$\left[\because \Delta=\frac{1}{2} b c \sin A=\frac{1}{2} c a \sin B=\frac{1}{2} a b \sin C\right] $

$= \frac{32 \Delta^3}{a^2 b^2 c^2}=$ ডানপক্ষ

$\therefore \sin (B+C-A)+\sin (C+A-B)+\sin (A+B-C)=\frac{32 \Delta^3}{a^2 b^2 c^2} $ (দেখানো হলো)

questions.question: যদি $4 \mathrm{~s}(\mathrm{~s}-\mathrm{b})=3 \mathrm{ca}$ হয়, তবে $\angle \mathrm{B}$ এর মান নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $4 \mathrm{~s}(\mathrm{~s}-\mathrm{b})=3 \mathrm{ca}$

বা, $4\left(\frac{a+b+c}{2}\right)\left(\frac{a+b+c}{2}-b\right)=3 c a$

বা, $4\left\{\left(\frac{a+b+c}{2}\right)^2-\left(\frac{a+b+c}{2}\right) \cdot b\right\}=3 c a$

বা, $4\left(\frac{a^2+b^2+c^2+2 a b+2 b c+2 c a}{4}-\frac{a b+b^2+b c}{2}\right)=3 c a$

বা, $\quad 4\left(\frac{a^2+b^2+c^2+2 a b+2 b c+2 c a-2 a b-2 b^2-2 b c}{4}\right)=3 c a$

বা, $a^2+c^2-b^2+2 c a=3 c a$

বা, $a^2+c^2-b^2=3 c a-2 c a$

বা, $a^2+c^2-b^2=c a$

বা, $\frac{\mathrm{a}^2+\mathrm{c}^2-\mathrm{b}^2}{2 \mathrm{ca}}=\frac{1}{2}$

বা, $\cos \mathrm{B}=\cos 60^{\circ}\left[\because \cos \mathrm{B}^{\circ}=\frac{\mathrm{a}^2+\mathrm{c}^2-\mathrm{b}^2}{2 \mathrm{ca}}\right]$

$\therefore \mathrm{B}=60^{\circ}$

$\therefore \quad \angle \mathrm{B}$ এর মান $60^{\circ}$.

questions.question: যদি $\tan ^2 \theta=1+2 \tan ^2 \varphi$ হয়, তবে দেখাও যে, $\cos 2 \varphi=1+2 \cos 2 \theta$.
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $\tan ^2 \theta=1+2 \tan ^2 \varphi$

বা, $2 \tan ^2 \varphi=\tan ^2 \theta-1$.

বা, $\tan ^2 \varphi=\frac{\tan ^2 \theta-1}{2}$

বা, $\frac{1}{\tan ^2 \varphi}=\frac{2}{\tan ^2 \theta-1}$

বা, $\frac{1-\tan ^2 \varphi}{1+\tan ^2 \varphi}=\frac{2-\tan ^2 \theta+1}{2+\tan ^2 \theta-1}$ [বিয়োজন-যোজন করে]

বা, $ \cos 2 \varphi =\frac{3-\tan ^2 \theta}{1+\tan ^2 \theta} $

$=\frac{1+\tan ^2 \theta+2-2 \tan ^2 \theta}{1+\tan ^2 \theta} $

$=\frac{1+\tan ^2 \theta}{1+\tan ^2 \theta}+\frac{2-2 \tan ^2 \theta}{1+\tan ^2 \theta}$

$ =1+2\left(\frac{1-\tan ^2 \theta}{1+\tan ^2 \theta}\right)=1+2 \cos 2 \theta $

$ \therefore \cos 2 \varphi =1+2 \cos 2 \theta .$ (দেখানো হলো)

questions.question: দৃশ্যকল্প-১ এর সাহায্যে প্রমাণ কর যে, $\cos ^2 \frac{x-y}{4}= \pm \frac{1}{4} \sqrt{a^2+b^2}+\frac{1}{2}$.
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $\mathrm{a}=\sin \mathrm{x}+\sin \mathrm{y}$

বা, $a=2 \sin \frac{x+y}{2} \cos \frac{x-y}{2}$ ........ (1)

এবং $\mathrm{b}=\cos \mathrm{x}+\cos \mathrm{y}$

বা, $b=2 \cos \frac{x+y}{2} \cos \frac{x-y}{2}$ ........ (2)

(1) ও (2) নং সমীকরণ বর্গ করে যোগ করে পাই,

$ a^2+b^2=4 \sin ^2\left(\frac{x+y}{2}\right) \cos ^2\left(\frac{x-y}{2}\right)+4 \cos ^2\left(\frac{x+y}{2}\right) \cos ^2\left(\frac{x-y}{2}\right)$

বা, $a^2+b^2=4 \cos ^2\left(\frac{x-y}{2}\right)\left[\sin ^2\left(\frac{x+y}{2}\right)+\cos ^2\left(\frac{x+y}{2}\right)\right]$

বা, $\frac{a^2+b^2}{4}=\cos ^2\left(\frac{x-y}{2}\right) \cdot 1\left[\because \sin ^2 \theta+\cos ^2 \theta=1\right]$

বা, $\frac{a^2+b^2}{4}=\left\{\cos \left(\frac{x-y}{2}\right)\right\}^2$

বা, $\frac{a^2+b^2}{4}=\left\{2 \cos ^2\left(\frac{x-y}{4}\right)-1\right\}^2$

বা, $\pm \sqrt{\frac{a^2+b^2}{4}}=2 \cos ^2\left(\frac{x-y}{4}\right)-1$

বা, $\pm \sqrt{\frac{a^2+b^2}{4}}+1=2 \cos ^2\left(\frac{x-y}{4}\right)$

বা, $\pm \frac{1}{2} \sqrt{a^2+b^2}+1=2 \cos ^2\left(\frac{x-y}{4}\right)$

বা, $\pm \frac{1}{4} \sqrt{a^2+b^2}+\frac{1}{2}=\cos ^2 \frac{x-y}{4}$

$\therefore \quad \cos ^2 \frac{x-y}{4}= \pm \frac{1}{4} \sqrt{a^2+b^2}+\frac{1}{2}$. (প্রমাণিত)

questions.question: দৃশ্যকল্প-২ এর সাহায্যে $\angle \mathrm{M}+\angle \mathrm{N}$ এর মান নির্ণয় কর যেখানে $l=\sqrt{\mathrm{m}^2+\mathrm{n}^2-\sqrt{2} \mathrm{mn}}$.
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $l=\sqrt{\mathrm{m}^2+\mathrm{n}^2-\sqrt{2} \mathrm{mn}}$

বা, $l^2=m^2+n^2-\sqrt{2} m n$ [বর্গ করে]

বা, $\mathrm{m}^2+\mathrm{n}^2-l^2=\sqrt{2} \mathrm{mn}$

বা, $\frac{m^2+n^2-l^2}{m n}=\sqrt{2}$

বা, $\frac{m^2+n^2-l^2}{2 m n}=\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}$ [উভয়পক্ষে 2 নারা ভাগ করে]

বা, $\cos L=\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}$

বা, $\cos \mathrm{L}=\cos 45^{\circ}$

$\therefore \mathbf{L}=45^{\circ}$

আমরা জানি,

$ \angle \mathrm{M}+\angle \mathrm{N}+\angle \mathrm{L}=180^{\circ} $

বা, $ \angle \mathrm{M}+\angle \mathrm{N}=180^{\circ}-\angle \mathrm{L} $

$\therefore \angle \mathrm{M}+\angle \mathrm{N}=180^{\circ}-45^{\circ}=135^{\circ} $

নির্ণেয় মান $135^{\circ}$.

questions.question: ত্রিভুজের ক্ষেত্রফল নির্ণয় কর যেখানে, $\mathrm{a}=2.5, \mathrm{c}=3.5$ এবং $\mathrm{B}=30^{\circ} .$
questions.answer:

$\mathrm{a}=2.5$ একক

$\mathrm{c}=3.5$ একক

এবং $\mathrm{B}_{\mathrm{F}}=30^{\circ}$

আমরা জানি, ত্রিভুজের ক্ষেত্রফল

$=\frac{1}{2} \mathrm{ca} \sin \mathrm{~B} $ বর্গ একক

questions.question: দৃশ্যকল্প-১ এর আলোকে দেখাও যে, $ \cos \frac{\alpha-\beta}{2}= \pm \sqrt{\frac{2 p^2-(m-n)^2}{4 m n}}$
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে,

 

$m \sin \alpha+n \sin \beta =P=m \cos \alpha+n \cos \beta $

 

$\therefore m \sin \alpha+n \sin \beta =P \ldots \ldots (1) $

 

এবং $m \cos \alpha+n \cos \beta =P \ldots \ldots (2) $

 

(1)নং এবং (2)নং কে বর্গ করে যোগ করি,

 

$(m \sin \alpha+n \sin \beta)^2+(m \cos \alpha+n \cos \beta)^2=P^2+P^2$

 

বা, $m^2 \sin ^2 \alpha+2 m n \sin \alpha \sin \beta+n^2 \sin ^2 \beta+m^2 \cos ^2 \alpha$

 

$+2 m n \cos \alpha \cos \beta+n^2 \cos ^2 \beta=2 P^2$

 

বা, $\mathrm{m}^2 \sin ^2 \alpha+ \mathrm{m}^2 \cos ^2 \alpha+\mathrm{n}^2 \sin ^2 \beta+\mathrm{n}^2 \cos ^2 \beta $

 

$+2 \mathrm{mn} \sin \alpha \cdot \sin \beta+2 \mathrm{mn} \cos \alpha \cos \beta=2 \mathrm{P}^2 $

 

বা, $\mathrm{m}^2\left(\sin ^2 \alpha+\cos ^2 \alpha\right) +\mathrm{n}^2\left(\sin ^2 \beta+\cos ^2 \beta\right) $

 

$ +2 \mathrm{mn}(\sin \alpha \sin \beta+\cos \alpha \cos \beta)=2 \mathrm{P}^2 $

 

বা, $m^2+n^2+2 m n \cos (\alpha-\beta)=2 P^2$

 

$[\because \sin ^2 \theta+\cos ^2 \theta=1$ এবং $ \cos (\mathrm{A}-\mathrm{B})=\cos \mathrm{A} \cos \mathrm{~B}+\sin \mathrm{A} \sin \mathrm{~B}]$

 

বা, $2 m n \cos (\alpha-\beta)=2 P^2-m^2-n^2$

 

বা, $\cos (\alpha-\beta)=\frac{2 P^2-m^2-n^2}{2 m n}$

 

বা, $\cos 2 \cdot \frac{\alpha-\beta}{2}=\frac{2 \mathrm{P}^2-\mathrm{m}^2-\mathrm{n}^2}{2 \mathrm{mn}}$

 

বা, $2 \cos ^2\left(\frac{\alpha-\beta}{2}\right)-1=\frac{2 \mathrm{P}^2-\mathrm{m}^2-\mathrm{n}^2}{2 \mathrm{mn}}\left[\cos 2 \mathrm{~A}=2 \cos ^2 \mathrm{~A}-1\right]$

 

বা, $2 \cos ^2\left(\frac{\alpha-\beta}{2}\right)=\frac{2 \mathrm{P}^2-\mathrm{m}^2-\mathrm{n}^2}{2 \mathrm{mn}}+1$

 

বা, $2 \cos ^2\left(\frac{\alpha-\beta}{2}\right)=\frac{2 \mathrm{P}^2-\mathrm{m}^2-\mathrm{n}^2+2 \mathrm{mn}}{2 \mathrm{mn}}=\frac{2 \mathrm{P}^2-\left(\mathrm{m}^2-2 \mathrm{mn}+\mathrm{n}^2\right)}{2 \mathrm{mn}}$

 

বা, $\cos ^2 \frac{\alpha-\beta}{2}=\frac{2 \mathrm{P}^2-(\mathrm{m}-\mathrm{n})^2}{4 \mathrm{mn}}$

 

$\therefore \quad \cos \frac{\alpha-\beta}{2}= \pm \sqrt{\frac{2 \mathrm{P}^2-(\mathrm{m}-\mathrm{n})^2}{4 \mathrm{mn}}}$. (দেখানো হলো)

questions.question: দৃশ্যকল্প-২ এ $x+y \neq 0$ হলে দেখাও যে, $\tan \frac{x}{2} \cdot \tan \frac{y}{2}=\frac{1}{3}$.
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $\sin x+\sin y=2 \sin (x+y)$

 

বা, $2 \sin \left(\frac{x+y}{2}\right) \cos \left(\frac{x-y}{2}\right)=2 \cdot \sin 2 \cdot \frac{x+y}{2}$

 

$\left[\because \sin C+\sin D=2 \sin \frac{C+D}{2} \cos \frac{C-D}{2}\right]$

 

বা, $2 \sin \left(\frac{x+y}{2}\right) \cos \left(\frac{x-y}{2}\right)=2.2 \sin \frac{x+y}{2} \cos \frac{x+y}{2}$

 

$[\because \sin 2 A=2 \sin A \cos A]$

 

বা, $2 \sin \frac{x+y}{2} \cos \frac{x-y}{2}-4 \sin \frac{x+y}{2} \cos \frac{x+y}{2}=0$

 

বা, $2 \sin \frac{x+y}{2}\left(\cos \frac{x-y}{2}-2 \cos \frac{x+y}{2}\right)=0$

 

বা, $\cos \frac{x-y}{2}-2 \cos \frac{x+y}{2}=0$

 

$\left[\because x+y \neq 0 \therefore \sin \frac{x+y}{2} \neq 0\right]$

 

বা, $\cos \frac{x-y}{2}=2 \cos \frac{x+y}{2}$

 

বা, $\cos \left(\frac{x}{2}-\frac{y}{2}\right)=2 \cos \left(\frac{x}{2}+\frac{y}{2}\right)$

 

বা, $\frac{\cos \left(\frac{x}{2}-\frac{y}{2}\right)}{\cos \left(\frac{x}{2}+\frac{y}{2}\right)}=2$

 

বা, $\frac{\cos \left(\frac{x}{2}-\frac{y}{2}\right)-\cos \left(\frac{x}{2}+\frac{y}{2}\right)}{\cos \left(\frac{x}{2}-\frac{y}{2}\right)+\cos \left(\frac{x}{2}+\frac{y}{2}\right)}=\frac{2-1}{2+1}$ [যোজন-বিয়োজন করে]

 

বা, $\frac{2 \sin \frac{x}{2} \sin \frac{y}{2}}{2 \cos \frac{x}{2} \sin \frac{y}{2}}=\frac{1}{3}$

 

বা, $\frac{\sin \frac{x}{2}}{\cos \frac{x}{2}} \frac{\sin \frac{y}{2}}{\cos \frac{y}{2}}=\frac{1}{3}$

 

$\therefore \tan \frac{x}{2} \cdot \tan \frac{y}{2}=\frac{1}{3}. $ (দেখানো হলো)

questions.question: $\tan 75^{\circ}$ এর মান নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer:
$\tan 75^{\circ} =\tan \left(45^{\circ}+30^{\circ}\right) $

 

$ =\frac{\tan 45^{\circ}+\tan 30^{\circ}}{1-\tan 45^{\circ} \cdot \tan 30^{\circ}} $

 

$ =\frac{1+\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}}{1-1 \cdot \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}}=\frac{\frac{\sqrt{3}+1}{\sqrt{3}}}{\frac{\sqrt{3}-1}{\sqrt{3}}} $

 

$ =\frac{\sqrt{3}+1}{\sqrt{3}} \times \frac{\sqrt{3}}{\sqrt{3}-1}=\frac{\sqrt{3}+1}{\sqrt{3}-1} $

 

$=\frac{(\sqrt{3}+1)(\sqrt{3}+1)}{(\sqrt{3}-1)(\sqrt{3}+1)} $

 

$=\frac{(\sqrt{3})^2+2 \sqrt{3}+1}{(\sqrt{3})^2-(1)^2}$

 

$ =\frac{4+2 \sqrt{3}}{2}=\frac{2(2+\sqrt{3})}{2} $

 

$=2+\sqrt{3} $

 

নির্ণেয় মান : $2+\sqrt{3}$.

questions.question: দৃশ্যকল্প-১ ব্যবহার করে প্রমাণ কর যে, $\frac{\mathrm{b}+\mathrm{c}}{\mathrm{a}}=2 \cos \frac{\mathrm{~B}-\mathrm{C}}{2} .8$
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $\mathrm{A}=60^{\circ}$

 

আমরা জানি, ত্রিভুজের সাইন সূত্রানুসারে,

 

$ \frac{\mathrm{a}}{\sin \mathrm{~A}}=\frac{\mathrm{b}}{\sin \mathrm{~B}}=\frac{\mathrm{c}}{\sin \mathrm{C}}=2 \mathrm{R} $

 

$\therefore \mathrm{a}=2 \mathrm{R} \sin \mathrm{~A}, \mathrm{~b}=2 \mathrm{R} \sin \mathrm{~B},$ $ \mathrm{c}=2 \mathrm{R} \sin \mathrm{C} $

 

এখন, $ \frac{\mathrm{b}+\mathrm{c}}{2 \mathrm{a}} =\frac{2 \mathrm{R} \sin \mathrm{~B}+2 \mathrm{R} \sin \mathrm{C}}{2 \cdot 2 \mathrm{R} \sin \mathrm{~A}} $

 

$=\frac{\sin \mathrm{B}+\sin \mathrm{C}}{2 \sin \mathrm{~A}}=\frac{2 \sin \frac{\mathrm{~B}+\mathrm{C}}{2} \cos \frac{\mathrm{~B}-\mathrm{C}}{2}}{2 \cdot 2 \sin \frac{\mathrm{~A}}{2} \cos \frac{\mathrm{~A}}{2}} $

 

$=\frac{\sin \left(\frac{\pi-\mathrm{A}}{2}\right) \cos \frac{\mathrm{B}-\mathrm{C}}{2}}{2 \sin \frac{\mathrm{~A}}{2} \cos \frac{\mathrm{~A}}{2}}$

 

$[\because \mathrm{~A}+\mathrm{B}+\mathrm{C}=\pi] $

 

$=\frac{\cos \frac{A}{2} \cos \frac{B-C}{2}}{2 \sin \frac{A}{2} \cos \frac{A}{2}} $

 

$=\frac{\cos \frac{B-C}{2}}{2 \sin 30^{\circ}}\left[\because A=60^{\circ}\right] $

 

বা, $\frac{b+c}{2 a}=\cos \frac{B-C}{2}$

 

$\therefore \quad \frac{b+c}{a}=2 \cos \frac{B-C}{2}$. (প্রমাণিত)

questions.question: দৃশ্যকল্প-২ এর আলোকে প্রমাণ কর যে, $ m^2+n^2+r^2+2 \cos 2 \alpha \cos 2 \beta \cos 2 \gamma $ $=2 .$
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে,

 

$m=\sin 2 \alpha $

 

$n=\sin 2 \beta $

 

$r=\sin 2 \gamma $

 

এবং $ \alpha+\beta+\gamma=\pi $

 

বামপক্ষ $=m^2+n^2+r^2+2 \cos 2 \alpha \cos 2 \beta \cos 2 \gamma $

 

$=\sin ^2 2 \alpha+\sin ^2 2 \beta+\sin ^2 2 \gamma+2 \cos 2 \alpha \cos 2 \beta \cos 2 \gamma $

 

$=\frac{1}{2}\left(2 \sin ^2 2 \alpha+2 \sin ^2 2 \beta\right)+\sin ^2 2 \gamma+2 \cos 2 \alpha \cos 2 \beta \cos 2 \gamma$

 

$=\frac{1}{2}(1-\cos 4 \alpha+1-\cos 4 \beta)+\sin ^2 2 \gamma+2 \cos 2 \alpha \cos 2 \beta \cos 2 \gamma $

 

$=1-\frac{1}{2}(\cos 4 \alpha+\cos 4 \beta)+\sin ^2 2 \gamma+2 \cos 2 \alpha \cos 2 \beta \cos 2 \gamma $

 

$=1-\frac{1}{2} \cdot 2 \cos \frac{4 \alpha+4 \beta}{2} \cos \frac{4 \alpha-4 \beta}{2}+\sin ^2 2 \gamma+2 \cos 2 \alpha \cos 2 \beta \cos 2 \gamma$

 

$=1-\cos (2 \alpha+2 \beta) \cos (2 \alpha-2 \beta)+\sin ^2 2 \gamma+2 \cos 2 \alpha \cos 2 \beta \cos 2 \gamma $

 

$=1-\cos (2 \pi-2 \gamma) \cos (2 \alpha-2 \beta)+1-\cos ^2 2 \gamma$

 

$+2 \cos 2 \alpha \cos 2 \beta \cos 2 \gamma$

 

$\left[\begin{array}{l}\because \alpha+\beta+\gamma=\pi \\ \therefore 2 \alpha+2 \beta=2 \pi-2 \gamma\end{array}\right]$

 

$=2-\cos 2 \gamma \cos (2 \alpha-2 \beta)-\cos ^2 2 \gamma+2 \cos 2 \alpha \cos 2 \beta \cos 2 \gamma $

 

$=2-\cos 2 \gamma\{\cos (2 \alpha-2 \beta)+\cos 2 \gamma\}+2 \cos 2 \alpha \cos 2 \beta \cos 2 \gamma$

 

$=2-\cos 2 \gamma\{\cos (2 \alpha-2 \beta)+\cos (2 \pi-2 \alpha-2 \beta)\}+2 \cos 2 \alpha \cos 2 \beta \cos 2 \gamma$

 

$=2-\cos 2 \gamma\{\cos (2 \alpha-2 \beta)+\cos (2 \alpha+2 \beta)\}+2 \cos 2 \alpha \cos 2 \beta \cos 2 \gamma $

 

$=2-\cos 2 \gamma \cdot 2 \cos 2 \alpha \cos 2 \beta+2 \cos 2 \alpha \cos 2 \beta \cos 2 \gamma $

 

$=2-2 \cos 2 \alpha \cos 2 \beta \cos 2 \gamma+2 \cos 2 \alpha \cos 2 \beta \cos 2 \gamma $

 

= 2 = ডানপক্ষ

 

$ \therefore \mathrm{m}^2+\mathrm{n}^2+\mathrm{r}^2+2 \cos 2 \alpha \cos 2 \beta \cos 2 \gamma=2 $ (প্রমাণিত)

questions.question: প্রমাণ কর যে, $\sec \left(\frac{\pi}{4}+\theta\right) \cdot \sec \left(\frac{\pi}{4}-\theta\right)=2 \sec 2 \theta$.
questions.answer:
বামপক্ষ $=\sec \left(\frac{\pi}{4}+\theta\right) \sec \left(\frac{\pi}{4}-\theta\right) $

 

$=\frac{1}{\cos \left(\frac{\pi}{4}+\theta\right)} \cdot \frac{1}{\cos \left(\frac{\pi}{4}-\theta\right)} $

 

$=\frac{1}{\frac{1}{2} \cdot 2 \cos \left(\frac{\pi}{4}+\theta\right) \cos \left(\frac{\pi}{4}-\theta\right)} $

 

$=\frac{2}{2 \cos \left(\frac{\frac{\pi}{2}+2 \theta}{2}\right) \cdot \cos \left(\frac{\frac{\pi}{2}-2 \theta}{2}\right)} $

 

$=\frac{2}{\cos \frac{\pi}{2}+\cos 2 \theta}\left[\cos C+\cos D=2 \cos \frac{C+D}{2} \cdot \cos \frac{C-D}{2}\right] $

 

$=\frac{2}{\cos 2 \theta}\left[\because \cos \frac{\pi}{2}=0\right]$

 

$=2 \cdot \frac{1}{\cos 2 \theta} $

 

$=2 \sec 2 \theta $

 

= ডানপক্ষ

 

$ \therefore \left(\sec \frac{\pi}{4}+\theta\right) \cdot\left(\sec \frac{\pi}{4}-\theta\right)=2 \sec 2 \theta$. (প্রমাণিত)

questions.question: $P=0$ হলে, দেখাও যে, $\tan (\alpha-\beta)=(1-n) \tan \alpha$.
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $\mathrm{P}=\frac{\mathrm{n} \sin \alpha \cos \alpha}{1-\mathrm{n} \sin ^2 \alpha}-\tan \beta$

 

$P=0 $ হলে, $ \frac{n \sin \alpha \cos \alpha}{1-n \sin ^2 \alpha}-\tan \beta=0$

 

বা, $\tan \beta=\frac{n \sin \alpha \cos \alpha}{1-n \sin ^2 \alpha}$

 

$= \frac{n \sin \alpha \cdot \cos \alpha \cdot \frac{1}{\cos ^2 \alpha}}{\left(1-n \sin ^2 \alpha\right) \cdot \frac{1}{\cos ^2 \alpha}}$


$= \frac{n \frac{\sin \alpha}{\cos \alpha} \cdot \frac{\cos \alpha}{\cos \alpha}}{\frac{1}{\cos ^2 \alpha}-\frac{n \sin ^2 \alpha}{\cos ^2 \alpha}} $


$= \frac{n \tan \alpha \cdot 1}{\sec ^2 \alpha-n \tan ^2 \alpha} $


$ \therefore \quad \tan \beta= \frac{n \tan \alpha}{1+\tan ^2 \alpha-n \tan ^2 \alpha} $


বামপক্ষ $=\tan (\alpha-\beta)$

 

$=\frac{\tan \alpha-\tan \beta}{1+\tan \alpha \tan \beta}=\frac{\tan \alpha-\frac{n \tan \alpha}{1+\tan ^2 \alpha-n \tan ^2 \alpha}}{1+\tan \alpha \frac{n \tan \alpha}{1+\tan ^2 \alpha-n \tan ^2 \alpha}} $

 

$ =\frac{\frac{\tan \alpha+\tan ^3 \alpha-n \tan ^3 \alpha-n \tan \alpha}{1+\tan ^2 \alpha-n \tan ^2 \alpha}}{\frac{1+\tan ^2 \alpha-n \tan ^2 \alpha+n \tan ^2 \alpha}{1+\tan ^2 \alpha-n \tan ^2 \alpha}} $

 

$ =\frac{\frac{\tan \alpha\left(1+\tan ^2 \alpha\right)-n \tan \alpha\left(1+\tan ^2 \alpha\right)}{1+\tan ^2 \alpha-n \tan ^2 \alpha}}{\frac{1+\tan ^2 \alpha}{1+\tan ^2 \alpha-n \tan ^2 \alpha}} $

 

$ =\frac{\left(1+\tan ^2 \alpha\right)(\tan \alpha-n \tan \alpha)}{1+\tan ^2 \alpha-n \tan ^2 \alpha} \times \frac{1+\tan ^2 \alpha-n \tan ^2 \alpha}{1+\tan ^2 \alpha} $

 

$=\frac{\left(1+\tan ^2 \alpha\right)(\tan \alpha-n \tan \alpha)}{\left.(1+\tan )^2 \alpha\right)} $

 

$=\frac{\tan \alpha-n \tan \alpha}{\tan \alpha}$

 

$=(1-n) \tan \alpha=$ ডানপক্ষ

 

$ \therefore  \tan (\alpha-\beta)=(1-n) \tan \alpha $ (দেশানো হলো)

questions.question: $\mathrm{A}+\mathrm{B}+\mathrm{C}=\pi$ এবং $\mathrm{Q}^2=3$ হলে, প্রমাণ কর যে, $\mathbf{A}=\mathbf{B}=\mathbf{C}$.
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে,

$\mathrm{A}+\mathrm{B}+\mathrm{C}=\pi$

এবং $\theta=\cot \mathrm{A}+\cot \mathrm{B}+\cot \mathrm{C}$

এখন, $\mathrm{A}+\mathrm{B}+\mathrm{C}=\pi$

বা, $\mathrm{B}+\mathrm{C}=\pi-\mathrm{A}$

বা, $\cot (B+C)=\cot (\pi-A)$

বা, $\frac{\cot B \cot C-1}{\cot B+\cot C}=-\cot A$

বা, $\cot \mathrm{B} \cot \mathrm{C}-1=-\cot \mathrm{A} \cot \mathrm{B}-\cot \mathrm{C} \cot \mathrm{A}$

$\therefore \quad \cot A \cot B+\cot B \cot C+\cot C \cot A=1$ ......... (1)

আবার, $\mathrm{Q}^2=3$ হলে,

$(\cot A+\cot B+\cot C)^2=3$

বা, $\cot ^2 \mathrm{~A}+\cot ^2 \mathrm{~B}+\cot ^2 \mathrm{C}+2 \cot \mathrm{~A} \cot \mathrm{~B}+2 \cot \mathrm{~B} \cot \mathrm{C}$

$+2 \cot C \cot A=3 \times 1=3(\cot A \cot B+\cot B \cot C+\cot C \cot A)$

[(1)নং হতে]

বা, $\cot ^2 \mathrm{~A}+\cot ^2 \mathrm{~B}+\cot ^2 \mathrm{C}+2 \cot \mathrm{~A} \cot \mathrm{~B}+2 \cot \mathrm{~B} \cot \mathrm{C}$

$+2 \cot C \cot A-3 \cot A \cot B-3 \cot B \cot C-3 \cot C \cot A=0$

বা, $\cot ^2 \mathrm{~A}+\cot ^2 \mathrm{~B}+\cot ^2 \mathrm{C}-\cot \mathrm{A} \cot \mathrm{B}-\cot \mathrm{B} \cot \mathrm{C}$

$-\cot C \cot A=0$

বা, $2 \cot ^2 \mathrm{~A}+2 \cot ^2 \mathrm{~B}+2 \cot ^2 \mathrm{C}-2 \cot \mathrm{~A} \cot \mathrm{~B}-2 \cot \mathrm{~B} \cot \mathrm{C}$

$-2 \cot \mathrm{C} \cot \mathrm{~A}=2 \times 0$ [উভয়পক্ষকে 2 দ্বারা গুণ করে]

বা, $\cot ^2 \mathrm{~A}-2 \cot \mathrm{~A} \cot \mathrm{~B}+\cot ^2 \mathrm{~B}+\cot ^2 \mathrm{~B}-2 \cot \mathrm{~B} \cot \mathrm{C}$

$+\cot ^2 \mathrm{C}+\cot ^2 \mathrm{C}-2 \cot \mathrm{C} \cot \mathrm{~A}+\cot ^2 \mathrm{~A}=0 $

$\therefore (\cot \mathrm{~A}-\cot \mathrm{B})^2+(\cot \mathrm{B}-\cot \mathrm{C})^2+(\cot \mathrm{C}-\cot \mathrm{A})^2=0 $

আমরা জানি, কতগুলো রাশির বর্গের সমষ্টি শূন্য হলে, রাশিগুলোর মান পৃথক পৃথকভাবে শূন্য হবে।

$\therefore(\cot A-\cot B)^2=0$

বা, $ \cot A=\cot B $

$ \therefore A=B$

আবার, $(\cot \mathrm{B}-\cot \mathrm{C})^2=0$

বা, $\cot B=\cot C$

$\therefore B=C$

আবার, $(\cot C-\cot A)^2=0$

বা, $\cot C=\cot A$

$\therefore C=A$

$\therefore \mathrm{A}=\mathrm{B}=\mathrm{C}$. (প্রমাণিত)

questions.question: $C=\frac{\pi}{2}$ হলে, দেখাও যে, $\left(1+\tan \frac{A}{2}\right)\left(1+\tan \frac{B}{2}\right)=2$.

= 2 = ডানপক্ষ

questions.question: $\angle \mathrm{B}=45^{\circ}, \angle \mathrm{C}=60^{\circ}$ এবং $\mathrm{a}=\sqrt{3}+1$ সে.মি. হলে, ত্রিভুজটির ক্ষেত্রফল নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer:

$\therefore \angle \mathrm{BAC} =180^{\circ}-(\angle \mathrm{B}+\angle \mathrm{C}) $

$=180^{\circ}-\left(45^{\circ}+60^{\circ}\right)=180^{\circ}-105^{\circ}=75^{\circ} $

$\Delta \mathrm{ABC}-$ এ, sine সূত্র প্রয়োগ ক

$\frac{c}{\sin C}=\frac{a}{\sin A} $

বা, $ c=\frac{a}{\sin A} \cdot \sin C$

$=\frac{\sqrt{3}+1}{\sin 75^{\circ}} \cdot \sin 60^{\circ} $

$=\frac{\sqrt{3}+1}{\sin \left(45^{\circ}+30^{\circ}\right)} \cdot \sin 60^{\circ} $

$=\frac{\sqrt{3}+1}{\sin 45^{\circ} \cos 30^{\circ}+\cos 45^{\circ} \sin 30^{\circ}} \cdot \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} $

$ =2 \sqrt{2} \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}=\sqrt{6} $ সে.মি.

$ =\frac{1}{2}(\sqrt{3}+1) \sqrt{3} $

questions.question: দেখাও যে, $\sin ^2\left(\frac{\pi}{4}+\frac{\theta}{2}\right)-\sin ^2\left(\frac{\pi}{4}-\frac{\theta}{2}\right)$ $=\sin \theta$.

$=\sin \left(\frac{\pi}{4}+\frac{\theta}{2}+\frac{\pi}{4}-\frac{\theta}{2}\right) \sin \left(\frac{\pi}{4}+\frac{\theta}{2}-\frac{\pi}{4}+\frac{\theta}{2}\right) $

$\therefore \sin ^2\left(\frac{\pi}{4}+\frac{\theta}{2}\right)-\sin ^2\left(\frac{\pi}{4}-\frac{\theta}{2}\right)=\sin \theta . $ (দেখানো হলো)

questions.answer:

বা, $4 \cos ^3 A-3 \cos A=\cos \theta$

 

বা, $\cos 3 \mathrm{~A}=\cos 60^{\circ}$

 

বা, $3 \mathrm{~A}=60^{\circ}$

$=\tan 20^{\circ} \tan 40^{\circ} \tan 60^{\circ} \tan 80^{\circ} $

$=\sqrt{3} \cdot \tan \left(3.20^{\circ}\right) $

= 3 = ডানপক্ষ

questions.question: দৃশ্যকল্প-২ হতে দেখাও যে, $\cos ^2 \mathrm{~A}+\cos ^2 \mathrm{~B}+\sin ^2 \mathrm{C}$ $=1+2 \cos \mathrm{~A} \cos \mathrm{~B} \sin \mathrm{C}$.
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $\cot \mathrm{A}+\cot \mathrm{B}+\cot \mathrm{C}=\cot \mathrm{A} \cot \mathrm{B} \cot \mathrm{C}$

 

বা, $\cot A+\cot B=\cot A \cot B \cot C-\cot C$

 

বা, $\cot \mathrm{A}+\cot \mathrm{B}=\cot \mathrm{C}(\cot \mathrm{A} \cot \mathrm{B}-1)$

 

বা, $\frac{1}{\cot \mathrm{C}}=\frac{\cot \mathrm{A} \cot \mathrm{B}-1}{\cot \mathrm{~B}+\cot \mathrm{A}}$

 

বা, $\frac{1}{\cot \mathrm{C}}=\cot (\mathrm{A}+\mathrm{B})$

 

বা, $\tan C=\cot (A+B)$

 

বা, $\cot \left(\frac{\pi}{2}-C\right)=\cot (A+B)$

 

বা, $ \frac{\pi}{2}-\mathrm{C}=\mathrm{A}+\mathrm{B} $

 

$ \therefore \mathrm{A}+\mathrm{B}+\mathrm{C}=\frac{\pi}{2} $

 

বামপক্ষ $=\cos ^2 \mathrm{~A}+\cos ^2 \mathrm{~B}+\sin ^2 \mathrm{C} $

 

$ =\frac{1}{2}\left[2 \cos ^2 \mathrm{~A}+2 \cos ^2 \mathrm{~B}\right]+\sin ^2 \mathrm{C} $

 

$ =\frac{1}{2}(1+\cos 2 \mathrm{~A}+1+\cos 2 \mathrm{~B})+\sin ^2 \mathrm{C}$

 

$ =\frac{1}{2} \cdot 2+\frac{1}{2}(\cos 2 \mathrm{~A}+\cos 2 \mathrm{~B})+\sin ^2 \mathrm{C} $

 

$ =1+\frac{1}{2} \cdot 2 \cos (\mathrm{~A}+\mathrm{B}) \cos (\mathrm{A}-\mathrm{B})+\sin ^2 \mathrm{C} $

 

$=1+\cos \left(\frac{\pi}{2}-\mathrm{C}\right) \cos (\mathrm{A}-\mathrm{B})+\sin ^2 \mathrm{C}$

 

$=1+\sin \mathrm{C} \cos (\mathrm{A}-\mathrm{B})+\sin ^2 \mathrm{C} $

 

$=1+\sin \mathrm{C}[\cos (\mathrm{A}-\mathrm{B})+\sin \mathrm{C}] $

 

$=1+\sin \mathrm{C}\left[\cos (\mathrm{A}-\mathrm{B})+\sin \left\{\frac{\pi}{2}-(\mathrm{A}+\mathrm{B})\right\}\right] $

 

$=1+\sin \mathrm{C}[\cos (\mathrm{A}-\mathrm{B})+\cos (\mathrm{A}+\mathrm{B})] $

 

$=1+\sin \mathrm{C} .2 \cos \mathrm{~A} \cos \mathrm{~B} $

 

$=1+2 \cos \mathrm{~A} \cos \mathrm{~B} \sin \mathrm{C} $

 

= ডানপক্ষ

 

$ \therefore \quad \cos ^2 \mathrm{~A}+\cos ^2 \mathrm{~B}+\sin ^2 \mathrm{C} $ $=1+2 \cos \mathrm{~A} \cos \mathrm{~B} \sin \mathrm{C} $ (প্রমাণিত)

questions.question: উদ্দীপকে $\sin \mathrm{P}+\cos \mathrm{P}=\sin \mathrm{Q}+\cos \mathrm{Q}$ হলে দেখাও যে, ত্রিভুজটি সমকোণী অথবা সমদ্বিবাহু।
questions.answer:
আমরা জানি, ত্রিভুজের তিন কোণের সমষ্টি $\pi$

$ {\left[\because \sin \mathrm{C}-\sin \mathrm{D}=2 \cos \frac{\mathrm{C}+\mathrm{D}}{2} \sin \frac{\mathrm{C}-\mathrm{D}}{2}\right.} $

এবং $ \left.\cos \mathrm{C}-\cos \mathrm{D}=2 \sin \frac{\mathrm{C}+\mathrm{D}}{2} \sin \frac{\mathrm{D}-\mathrm{C}}{2}\right]$

হয়, $\cos \frac{P+Q}{2}-\sin \frac{P+Q}{2}=0$

বা, $\cos \frac{\mathrm{P}+\mathrm{Q}}{2}=\sin \frac{\mathrm{P}+\mathrm{Q}}{2}$

বা, $1=\frac{\sin \frac{P+Q}{2}}{\cos \frac{P+Q}{2}}$

বা, $\tan \frac{P+Q}{2}=1$

অথবা, $\sin \frac{P-Q}{2}=0$

বা, $\mathrm{P}-\mathrm{Q}=0$

$\therefore \quad P=Q$

$\therefore \triangle \mathrm{PQR}$ সমদ্বিবাহু।

যেহেতু $\angle R=\frac{\pi}{2}$, সেহেতু $\triangle P Q R$ সমকোণী

$\therefore$ ত্রিভুজটি সমকোণী অথবা সমদ্বিবাহু। (দেখানো হলো)

questions.question: উদ্দীপকের ত্রিভুজটির অন্তঃবৃত্তের ব্যাসার্ধ $\mathrm{r}_1$ ও বহিঃবৃত্তের ব্যাসার্ধ $\mathrm{r}_2$ । যদি $\mathrm{PQ}=10, \mathrm{QR}=6$ এবং RP $=8$ হয়, তাহলে দেখাও যে, $\mathrm{r}_1: \mathrm{r}_2=2: 5$.
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে,

PQ = 10 একক

QR = 6 একক

এবং RP = 8 একক

$\therefore \quad \triangle \mathrm{PQR}$ এর পরিসীমা,

$2 \mathrm{~S}=(\mathrm{PQ}+\mathrm{QR}+\mathrm{PR})$ একক

$=10+6+8=24 $ একক

$\therefore$ অর্ধপরিসীমা, $S=\frac{24}{2}$ একক $=12$ একক

$\therefore \triangle \mathrm{PQR}$ এর ক্ষেত্রফল,

$\Delta =\sqrt{S(S-P Q)(S-Q R)(S-P Q)}$ বর্গ একক

$ =\sqrt{12(12-10)(12-6)(12-8)} $ বর্গ একক

$ =\sqrt{12 \times 2 \times 6 \times 4} $ বর্গ একক

$ =\sqrt{576}=24 $ বর্গ একক

$\therefore \mathrm{PQR}$ ত্রিভুজের অন্তঃব্যাসার্ধ,

$\mathrm{r}_1=\frac{\Delta}{\mathrm{S}}=\frac{25}{12}=2 $ একক

এবং PQR ত্রিভুজের বহিঃব্যাসার্ধ,

$r_2 =\frac{P Q \cdot Q R \cdot P R}{4 \Delta} $

$ =\frac{10.6 \cdot 8}{4.24}$ একক

$ =\frac{480}{96} $ একক = 5 একক

$\therefore r_1 : r_2=2: 5 .$ (দেখানো হলো)

questions.question: প্রমাণ কর যে, $\sin 33^{\circ}+\cos 33^{\circ}=\sqrt{2} \cos 12^{\circ}$.
questions.answer:
বামপক্ষ $=\sin 33^{\circ}+\cos 33^{\circ} $

$=\sin 33^{\circ}+\cos \left(90^{\circ}-57^{\circ}\right)$

$=\sin 33^{\circ}+\sin 57^{\circ} $

$=2 \sin 45^{\circ} \cos 12^{\circ} $

$=2 \cdot \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}} \cdot \cos 12^{\circ} $

$=\sqrt{2} \cos 12^{\circ}=$ ডানপক্ষ

$ \therefore \quad \sin 33^{\circ} +\cos 33^{\circ}=\sqrt{2} \cos 12^{\circ} . $ (প্রমাণিত)

questions.question: দৃশ্যকল্প-১ এ, $\mathrm{A}+\mathrm{B}+\mathrm{C}=\pi$ হলে, প্রমাণ কর যে, $f(4 \mathrm{~A})+f(4 \mathrm{~B})+f(4 \mathrm{C})$ $=-4 f(2 \mathrm{~A}) f(2 \mathrm{~B}) f(2 \mathrm{C})$.
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে,

$ \mathrm{A}+\mathrm{B}+\mathrm{C}=\pi, f(\mathrm{x})=\sin \mathrm{x} $

$\therefore f(4 \mathrm{~A})=\sin 4 \mathrm{~A}, f(4 \mathrm{~B})=\sin 4 \mathrm{~B}, f(4 \mathrm{C})=\sin 4 \mathrm{C} $

$ f(2 \mathrm{~A})=\sin 2 \mathrm{~A}, f(2 \mathrm{~B})=\sin 2 \mathrm{~B}, f(2 \mathrm{C})=\sin 2 \mathrm{C} $

বামপক্ষ $=f(4 \mathrm{~A})+f(4 \mathrm{~B})+f(4 \mathrm{C}) $

$=\sin 4 \mathrm{~A}+\sin 4 \mathrm{~B}+\sin 4 \mathrm{C} $

$=2 \sin (2 \mathrm{~A}+2 \mathrm{~B}) \cos (2 \mathrm{~A}-2 \mathrm{~B})+\sin 4 \mathrm{C} $

$=2 \sin (2 \pi-2 \mathrm{C}) \cos (2 \mathrm{~A}-2 \mathrm{~B})+\sin 4 \mathrm{C}$

$=-2 \sin 2 \mathrm{C} \cos (2 \mathrm{~A}-2 \mathrm{~B})+\sin 2.2 \mathrm{C} $

$=-2 \sin 2 \mathrm{C} \cos (2 \mathrm{~A}-2 \mathrm{~B})+2 \sin 2 \mathrm{C} \cos 2 \mathrm{C} $

$ =-2 \sin 2 \mathrm{C}[\cos (2 \mathrm{~A}-2 \mathrm{~B})-\cos 2 \mathrm{C}] $

$=-2 \sin 2 \mathrm{C}[\cos (2 \mathrm{~A}-2 \mathrm{~B})-\cos \{2 \pi-(2 \mathrm{~A}+2 \mathrm{~B})\}] $

$=-2 \sin 2 \mathrm{C}[\cos (2 \mathrm{~A}-2 \mathrm{~B})-\cos (2 \mathrm{~A}+2 \mathrm{~B})] $

$ =-2 \sin 2 \mathrm{C} .2 \sin 2 \mathrm{~A} \sin 2 \mathrm{~B} $

$=-4 \sin 2 \mathrm{~A} \sin 2 \mathrm{~B} \sin 2 \mathrm{C} $

$=-4 f(2 \mathrm{~A}) f(2 \mathrm{~B}) f(2 \mathrm{C}) $

= ডানপক্ষ

$\therefore \quad f(4 \mathrm{~A}) +f(4 \mathrm{~B})+f(4 \mathrm{C})$ $=-4 f(2 \mathrm{~A}) f(2 \mathrm{~B}) f(2 \mathrm{C}) $ (প্রমাণিত)

questions.question: দৃশ্যকল্প-২ হতে প্রমাণ কর যে, $b^4+c^4+a^4-\sqrt{3} b^2 c^2$ $=2 a^2\left(b^2+c^2\right)$.
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে,

বামপক্ষ $=b^4+c^4+a^4-\sqrt{3} b^2 c^2 $

$ =\left(b^2\right)^2+\left(c^2\right)^2+\left(-a^2\right)^2+2 b^2 c^2-2 a^2 b^2-2 c^2 a^2 $

$ -\sqrt{3} b^2 c^2-2 b^2 c^2+2 a^2 c^2+2 a^2 b^2 $

$ =\left(b^2+c^2-a^2\right)^2-\sqrt{3} b^2 c^2-2 b^2 c^2+2 a^2\left(b^2+c^2\right) $

$ =\left(\frac{b^2+c^2-a^2}{2 b c} \times 2 b c\right)^2-\sqrt{3} b^2 c^2-2 b^2 c^2+2 a^2\left(b^2+c^2\right) $

$ =(\cos A \times 2 b c)^2-\sqrt{3} b^2 c^2-2 b^2 c^2+2 a^2\left(b^2+c^2\right) $

$ =\left(\cos 15^{\circ} \times 2 b c\right)^2-\sqrt{3} b^2 c^2-2 b^2 c^2+2 a^2\left(b^2+c^2\right) $

$ =\left(\frac{\sqrt{3}+1}{2 \sqrt{2}}\right)^2 \times 4 b^2 c^2-\sqrt{3} b^2 c^2-2 b^2 c^2+2 a^2\left(b^2+c^2\right) $

$=\frac{3+1+2 \sqrt{3}}{4 \times 2} \times 4 b^2 c^2-\sqrt{3} b^2 c^2-2 b^2 c^2+2 a^2\left(b^2+c^2\right) $

$=(2+\sqrt{3}) b^2 c^2-\sqrt{3} b^2 c^2-2 b^2 c^2+2 a^2\left(b^2+c^2\right) $

$=2 b^2 c^2+\sqrt{3} b^2 c^2-\sqrt{3} b^2 c^2-2 b^2 c^2+2 a^2\left(b^2+c^2\right) $

$=2 a^2\left(b^2+c^2\right)=$ ডানপক্ষ

$ \therefore \quad b^4 +c^4+a^4-\sqrt{3} b^2 c^2 $ $=2 a^2\left(b^2+c^2\right) $ (প্রমাণিত)

questions.question: দেখাও যে, $\sec \left(\frac{x}{2}+\frac{\pi}{4}\right)=\frac{2}{\sqrt{2-2 \sin x}}$
questions.answer:
বামপক্ষ $ =\sec \left(\frac{x}{2}+\frac{\pi}{4}\right) $

 

$=\frac{1}{\cos \left(\frac{x}{2}+\frac{\pi}{4}\right)}$ $\left[\because \sec \theta=\frac{1}{\cos \theta}\right] $

 

$=\frac{1}{\cos \frac{x}{2} \cos \frac{\pi}{4}-\sin \frac{x}{2} \sin \frac{\pi}{4}}$

 

$[\because \cos (A+B)=\cos A \cos B-\sin A \sin B]$

 

$=\frac{1}{\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}} \cos \frac{x}{2}-\sin \frac{x}{2} \cdot \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}} $

 

$=\frac{1}{\frac{\cos \frac{x}{2}-\sin \frac{x}{2}}{\sqrt{2}}}=\frac{\sqrt{2}}{\cos \frac{x}{2}-\sin \frac{x}{2}} $

 

$=\frac{\sqrt{2} \cdot \sqrt{2}}{\sqrt{2} \cdot \sqrt{\left(\cos \frac{x}{2}-\sin \frac{x}{2}\right)^2}} $

 

$=\frac{2}{\sqrt{2} \sqrt{\cos ^2 \frac{x}{2}+\sin ^2 \frac{x}{2}-2 \cdot \sin \frac{x}{2} \cdot \cos \frac{x}{2}}}$

 

$=\frac{2}{\sqrt{2} \sqrt{1-\sin 2 \frac{x}{2}}}=\frac{2}{\sqrt{2(1-\sin x)}} $

 

$=\frac{2}{\sqrt{2-2 \sin x}}=$ ডানপক্ষ 

 

$ \therefore \sec \left(\frac{x}{2}+\frac{\pi}{4}\right)=\frac{2}{\sqrt{2-2 \sin x}} $ (দেখানো হলো)

questions.question: প্রমাণ কর যে, $16 \sin \frac{\mathrm{~B}}{3} \sin \frac{5 \mathrm{~B}}{3} \sin \frac{7 \mathrm{~B}}{3}=\operatorname{cosec} \mathrm{B}$.
questions.answer:
চিত্র হতে, $\triangle \mathrm{ABC}-$ এ, $\mathrm{B}=30^{\circ}$

$\therefore \frac{\mathrm{B}}{3} =10^{\circ} $

বামপক্ষ $=16 \sin \frac{\mathrm{~B}}{3} \sin \frac{5 \mathrm{~B}}{3} \sin \frac{7 \mathrm{~B}}{3}$

$ =16 \sin 10^{\circ} \sin 50^{\circ} \sin 70^{\circ} $

$ =8 \cdot\left(2 \sin 50^{\circ} \sin 10^{\circ}\right) \sin 70^{\circ} $

$ =8 \cdot\left(2 \sin \frac{40^{\circ}+60^{\circ}}{2} \cdot \sin \frac{60^{\circ}-40^{\circ}}{2}\right) \cdot \sin 70^{\circ}$

$ =8\left(\cos 40^{\circ}-\cos 60^{\circ}\right) \sin 70^{\circ} $

$ {\left[\because \cos \mathrm{C}-\cos \mathrm{D}=2 \sin \frac{\mathrm{C}+\mathrm{D}}{2} \cdot \sin \frac{\mathrm{D}-\mathrm{C}}{2}\right] } $

$= 8 \cos 40^{\circ} \sin 70^{\circ}-8 \frac{1}{2} \sin 70^{\circ} $

$=4 \cdot\left(2 \sin 70^{\circ} \cos 40^{\circ}\right)-4 \sin 70^{\circ} $

$= 4\left(2 \sin \frac{110^{\circ}+30^{\circ}}{2} \cdot \cos \frac{110^{\circ}-30^{\circ}}{2}\right) \cdot 4 \sin 70^{\circ} $

$= 4\left(\sin 110^{\circ}+\sin 30^{\circ}\right)-4 \sin 70^{\circ} $

${\left[\because \sin \mathrm{C}+\sin \mathrm{D}=2 \sin \frac{\mathrm{C}+\mathrm{D}}{2} \cos \frac{\mathrm{C}-\mathrm{D}}{2}\right] }$

$ = 4 \sin 110^{\circ}+4 \frac{1}{2}-4 \sin 70^{\circ} $

$= 4 \sin \left(90^{\circ}+20^{\circ}\right)+2-4 \sin \left(90^{\circ}-20^{\circ}\right) $

$= 4 \cos 20^{\circ}+2-4 \cdot \cos 20^{\circ} $

= 2

ডানপক্ষ $= \operatorname{cosec} \mathrm{B} $

$= \operatorname{cosec} 30^{\circ} $

$ = 2$

$ \therefore 16 \sin \frac{\mathrm{~B}}{3} \sin \frac{5 \mathrm{~B}}{3} \sin \frac{7 \mathrm{~B}}{3}$ $=\operatorname{cosec} \mathrm{B} $. (প্রমাণিত)

questions.question: $\mathrm{A}=45^{\circ}$ এবং $\mathrm{C}=(\sqrt{3}+1)$ সে.মি. হলে, ABC ত্রিভুজের ক্ষেত্রফল নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $\mathrm{A}=45^{\circ}, \mathrm{B}=30^{\circ}$

এবং বাহু, $\mathrm{C}=\sqrt{3}+1$ সে.মি.

$\therefore \angle \mathrm{ACB} =180^{\circ}-(\angle \mathrm{B}+\angle \mathrm{A}) $

$ =180^{\circ}-\left(30^{\circ}+45^{\circ}\right) $

$ =180^{\circ}-75^{\circ}=105^{\circ}$

$\Delta \mathrm{ABC}-$ এ সাইন সূত্র প্রয়োগ করে পাই,

$ \frac{\mathrm{a}}{\sin \mathrm{~A}}=\frac{\mathrm{b}}{\sin \mathrm{~B}}=\frac{\mathrm{C}}{\sin \mathrm{C}} $

বা, $ \frac{\mathrm{a}}{\sin 45^{\circ}}=\frac{\mathrm{b}}{\sin 30^{\circ}}=\frac{\sqrt{3}+1}{\sin 105^{\circ}} \ldots \ldots \text { (i) } $

এখন, $ \sin 105^{\circ}=\sin \left(60^{\circ}+45^{\circ}\right)$

$=\sin 60^{\circ} \cos 45^{\circ}+\sin 45^{\circ} \cos 60^{\circ} $

$[\because \sin (A+B)=\sin A \cos B+\cos A \sin B] $

$ =\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} \cdot \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}+\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}} \cdot \frac{1}{2}=\frac{\sqrt{3}+1}{2 \sqrt{2}}$

(i) নং হতে পাই,

$\frac{a}{\sin 45^{\circ}}=\frac{b}{\sin 30^{\circ}}=\frac{\sqrt{3}+1}{\frac{\sqrt{3}+1}{2 \sqrt{2}}}$

বা, $\frac{\mathrm{a}}{\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}}=\frac{\mathrm{b}}{\frac{1}{2}}=\frac{\sqrt{3}+1}{\frac{\sqrt{3}+1}{2 \sqrt{2}}}$

বা, $\sqrt{2} a=2 b=\frac{\sqrt{3}+1}{1} \times \frac{2 \sqrt{2}}{\sqrt{3}+1}$

বা, $ \sqrt{2} a=2 b=2 \sqrt{2}$

$ \therefore \sqrt{2} a=2 \sqrt{2} $

বা, $a=2$

এবং $2 b=2 \sqrt{2} $

$ \therefore b=\sqrt{2}$

$\therefore \triangle \mathrm{ABC} $ এর ক্ষেত্রফল $ =\frac{1}{2} \mathrm{ac} \sin \mathrm{~B} $ বর্গ একক

$ =\frac{1}{2} \times 2(\sqrt{3}+1) \times \sin 30^{\circ} $ বর্গ একক

$ =(\sqrt{3}+1) \times \frac{1}{2} $ বর্গ একক

$ =\frac{\sqrt{3}+1}{2} $ বর্গ একক $=\frac{1+\sqrt{3}}{2}$ বর্গ একক

নির্ণেয় ক্ষেত্রফল : $\frac{1+\sqrt{3}}{2}$ বর্গ একক।

questions.question: প্রমাণ কর যে, $\tan 33^{\circ}+\tan 12^{\circ}+\tan 33^{\circ} \cdot \tan 12^{\circ}=1$.
questions.answer:
আমরা জানি, $\tan 45^{\circ}=1$

 

বা, $\tan \left(33^{\circ}+12^{\circ}\right)=1$

 

বা, $\frac{\tan 33^{\circ}+\tan 12^{\circ}}{1-\tan 33^{\circ} \tan 12^{\circ}}=1$

 

$\left[\because \tan (\mathrm{~A}+\mathrm{B})=\frac{\tan \mathrm{A}+\tan \mathrm{B}}{1-\tan \mathrm{A} \cdot \tan \mathrm{B}}\right]$

 

বা, $\tan 33^{\circ}+\tan 12^{\circ}=1-\tan 33^{\circ} \cdot \tan 12^{\circ}$

 

$\therefore \tan 33^{\circ}+\tan 12^{\circ}+\tan 33^{\circ} \tan 12^{\circ}=1$ (প্রমাণিত)

questions.question: $(a+b+c)(b+c-a)=3 b c$ হলে দেখাও যে, $\frac{b+c}{a}=2 \cos \frac{B-C}{2}$
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে,

$(a+b+c)(b+c-a)=3 b c$

বা, $\{(b+c)+a\}\{(b+c)-a\}=3 b c$

বা, $(b+c)^2-a^2=3 b c$

বা, $b^2+2 b c+c^2-a^2=3 b c$

বা, $b^2+c^2-a^2=3 b c-2 b c$,

বা, $b^2+c^2-a^2=b c$

বা, $\frac{b^2+c^2-a^2}{2 b c}=\frac{b c}{2 b c}$

বা, $\cos \mathrm{A}=\frac{1}{2}=\cos 60^{\circ}$

$\therefore \mathrm{A}=60^{\circ}$

আমরা জানি, ত্রিভুজের সাইন সূত্রানুসারে,

$\therefore \frac{a}{\sin A}=\frac{b}{\sin B}=\frac{c}{\sin C}=2 R $

$ \therefore a=2 R \sin A, b=2 R \sin B, $ $c=2 R \sin C$

এখন, $\frac{b+c}{2 a}=\frac{2 R \sin B+2 R \sin C}{2 \cdot 2 R \sin A}$ $=\frac{\sin B+\sin C}{2 \sin A}=\frac{2 \sin \frac{B+C}{2} \cos \frac{B-C}{2}}{2 \cdot 2 \sin \frac{A}{2} \cos \frac{A}{2}} $

$=\frac{\sin \left(\frac{\pi-A}{2}\right) \cos \frac{B-C}{2}}{2 \sin \frac{A}{2} \cos \frac{A}{2}}$ $[\because A+B+C=\pi]$

$= \frac{\cos \frac{A}{2} \cos \frac{B-C}{2}}{2 \sin \frac{A}{2} \cos \frac{A}{2}}$

$ = \frac{\cos \frac{B-C}{2}}{2 \sin 30^{\circ}}\left[\because A=60^{\circ}\right] $

বা, $ \frac{b+c}{2 a}= \cos \frac{B-C}{2} $

$\therefore \frac{b+c}{a}= 2 \cos \frac{B-C}{2} $ (দেখানো হলো)

questions.question:
প্রমাণ কর যে, $\mathrm{a}^3 \cos (2 \mathrm{C}+\mathrm{A}-\pi)+\mathrm{b}^3 \cos (2 \mathrm{~A}+\mathrm{B}-\pi)$

$=3 a b c-c^3 \cos (2 B+C-\pi)$
questions.answer:
চিত্রে, $\triangle \mathrm{ABC}-$ এ, $\mathrm{A}+\mathrm{B}+\mathrm{C}=\pi$

এখন, $\mathrm{a}^3 \cos (2 \mathrm{C}+\mathrm{A}-\pi)$

$=a^3 \cos (2 C+A-A-B-C)=a^3 \cos (C-B) $

$ =a^3(\cos C \cos B+\sin C \sin B) $

$[\because \cos (A-B)=\cos A \cos B+\sin A \cdot \sin B] $

$ =a(a \cos C a \cos B+a \sin C a \sin B)$

$ \left.=a(b-c \cos A)(c-b \cos A)+2 R \sin A \cdot \frac{c}{2 R} \cdot 2 R \sin A \cdot \frac{b}{2 R}\right] $

[যেকোনো $\triangle A B C-এ, a=b \cos C+c \cos B, b=c \cos A+a \cos C$

$C=a \cos B+b \cos A $ এবং $ \frac{a}{\sin A}=\frac{b}{\sin B}=\frac{c}{\sin C}=2 ]$

$ =a\left[b c-c^2 \cos A-b^2 \cos A+b c \cos ^2 A+b c \sin ^2 A\right]$

$ =a\left[b c-\left(b^2+c^2\right) \cos A+b c\left(\cos ^2 A+\sin ^2 A\right)\right] $

$ =a\left[b c-\left(b^2+c^2\right) \cos A+b c\right]\left[\because \sin ^2 \theta+\cos ^2 \theta=1\right] $

$ =a\left[2 b c-\left(b^2+c^2\right) \cos A\right] $

$ \therefore a^3 \cos (2 C+a-\pi)=2 a b c-a\left(b^2+c^2\right) \cos A \ldots \ldots . . (1)$


অনুরূপভাবে,

$ b^3 \cos (2 A+B-\pi)=2 a b c-b\left(c^2+a^2\right) \cos B $ .......... (2)

$ c^3 \cos (2 B+C-\pi)=2 a b c-c\left(a^2+b^2\right) \cos C $ .......... (3)

(1) নং, (2) নং ও (3) নং সমীকরণ যোগ করে পাই,

$a^3 \cos (2 C+A-\pi)+b^3 \cos (2 A+B-\pi) +c^3 \cos (2 B+C-\pi)$

$=2 a b c-a\left(b^2+c^2\right) \cos A+2 a b c-b(c^2$ $+a^2 \cos B +2 a b c-c\left(a^2+b^2\right) \cos C$

$=6 a b c-a b^2 \cos A-a c^2 \cos A-b c^2 \cos B$

$-a^2 b \cos B -a^2 c \cos C-b^2 c \cos C $

$=6 a b c-[a b^2 \cos A+a^2 b \cos B+a c^2 \cos A$

$+a^2 c \cos C+b c^2 \cos B+b^2 C \cos C$

$ =6 a b c-[a b(b \cos A+a \cos B)+$

$a c(c \cos A+a \cos C) +b c(c \cos B+b \cos C)$

[যেকোনো ত্রিভুজ $ABC$ -এ, $a=b \cos C+c \cos B$ $ b=c \cos A+a \cos C, C=a \cos B+b \cos A] $

$=6 a b c-[a b c+a b c+a b c] $

$ =6 a b c-3 a b c=3 a b c$

$\therefore a^3 \cos (2 C+A-\pi)+b^3 \cos (2 A+B-\pi) $

$=3 a b c-c^3 \cos (2 B+C-\pi) $ (প্রমাণিত)

questions.question: প্রমাণ কর যে, $2 \tan 20^{\circ}=\tan 55^{\circ}-\tan 35^{\circ}$.
questions.answer:
আমরা পাই,

$ \tan 20^{\circ}=\tan \left(55^{\circ}-35^{\circ}\right) $

বা, $ \tan 20^{\circ}=\frac{\tan 55^{\circ}-\tan 35^{\circ}}{1+\tan 55^{\circ} \tan 35^{\circ}} $

বা, $\tan 20^{\circ}+\tan 20^{\circ} \cdot \tan 55^{\circ} \cdot \tan 35^{\circ}=\tan 55^{\circ}-\tan 35^{\circ} $

বা, $\tan 20^{\circ}+\tan 20^{\circ} \cdot \tan \left(90^{\circ}-35^{\circ}\right) \tan 35^{\circ}=\tan 55^{\circ}-\tan 35^{\circ}$

বা, $\tan 20^{\circ}+\tan 20^{\circ} \cdot \cot 35^{\circ} \tan 35^{\circ}=\tan 55^{\circ}-\tan 35^{\circ} $

বা, $\tan 20^{\circ}+\tan 20^{\circ} \cdot \frac{\tan 35^{\circ}}{\tan 35^{\circ}}=\tan 55^{\circ}-\tan 35^{\circ} $

$ \therefore 2 \tan 20^{\circ}=\tan 55^{\circ}-\tan 35^{\circ} $. (প্রমাণিত)

questions.question: দৃশ্যকল্প-১ এর আলোকে প্রমাণ কর যে, $\cos ^2 x+\cos ^2\left(\frac{x+y}{2}\right)+\cos ^2 y=\frac{3}{2}$
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে,

$x=\alpha-120^{\circ}, y=\alpha+120^{\circ} $

বামপক্ষ $=\cos ^2 x+\cos ^2\left(\frac{x+y}{2}\right)+\cos ^2 y $

$ = \frac{1}{2}\left\{2 \cos ^2\left(\alpha-120^{\circ}\right)+2 \cos ^2\left(\frac{\alpha-120^{\circ}+\alpha+120^{\circ}}{2}\right)+2 \cos ^2\left(\alpha+120^{\circ}\right)\right\} $

$= \frac{1}{2}\left\{1+\cos 2\left(\alpha-120^{\circ}\right)+1+\cos 2 \alpha+1+\cos 2\left(\alpha+120^{\circ}\right)\right\} $

$= \frac{1}{2}\left\{3+\cos \left(2 \alpha-240^{\circ}\right)+\cos \left(2 \alpha+240^{\circ}\right)+\cos 2 \alpha\right\} $

$= \frac{1}{2}\left\{3+2 \cos 2 \alpha \cos 240^{\circ}+\cos 2 \alpha\right\} $

questions.question: $\frac{1}{T-m}+\frac{1}{T-l}=\frac{3}{T}$ হলে, দৃশ্যকল্প-২ এর ত্রিভূজের $R$ কোণ নির্ণয় কর ।
questions.answer:
দৃশ্যকল্প-২ হতে, $\mathrm{T}=\mathrm{I}+\mathrm{m}+\mathrm{n}$

 

$ \therefore \frac{1}{T-m}+\frac{1}{T-l}=\frac{3}{T} $

 

$\Rightarrow \frac{1}{l+m+n-m}+\frac{1}{l+m+n-l}=\frac{3}{l+m+n}$

 

$\Rightarrow \frac{1}{l+n}+\frac{1}{m+n}=\frac{3}{l+m+n}$

 

$\Rightarrow \frac{m+n+l+n}{(l+n)(m+n)}=\frac{3}{l+m+n}$

 

$\Rightarrow \frac{(l+m+n)+n}{(l+n)(m+n)}=\frac{3}{l+m+n}$

 

$\Rightarrow(l+m+n)^{2}+n(l+m+n)=3(l+n)(m+n)$

 

$\Rightarrow l^{2}+m^{2}+n^{2}+2 l m+2 m n+2 n l+n l+n m+n^{2}=3 l m+3 l n+3 m n+3 n^{2}$

 

$\Rightarrow l^{2}+m^{2}-n^{2}=l m$

 

$\Rightarrow \frac{l^{2}+m^{2}-n^{2}}{2 l m}=\frac{l m}{2 l m}$

 

$\Rightarrow \cos R=\frac{1}{2}$

 

$\Rightarrow \cos R=\cos 60^{\circ}$

 

$\therefore R=60^{\circ}$

questions.question: যদি $p^{4}+q^{4}+r^{4}=2 p^{2}\left(q^{2}+r^{2}\right)$ হয়, তবে দেখাও যে, $\mathrm{S}=45^{\circ}$ অথবা $135^{\circ}$

questions.question: উদ্দীপক-২ থেকে প্রমাণ কর যে, $\tan \frac{c-A}{2}=\frac{c-a}{c+a} \cot \frac{B}{2}$

$=1-\sin \frac{C}{2}\left\{\sin \left(\frac{A}{2}-\frac{A+B}{2}\right)-\cos \frac{A-B}{2}\right\}$


$=1-\sin \frac{C}{2}\left(\cos \frac{A-B}{2}-\cos \frac{A-B}{2}\right)$


$=1-\sin \frac{C}{2}\left\{\cos \left(\frac{A}{2}-\frac{B}{2}\right)-\cos \left(\frac{A}{2}+\frac{B}{2}\right)\right\}$


$=1-\sin \frac{C}{2} \cdot 2 \cos \frac{A}{2} \sin \frac{B}{2}$

questions.question: উদ্দীপক হতে প্রমাণ কর যে, $ 1+4 \sin \frac{Q+R}{4} \cdot \sin \frac{R+P}{4} \cdot \sin \frac{P+Q}{4}=\sin \frac{P}{2}+\sin \frac{Q}{2}+\sin \frac{R}{2}. $
questions.answer:
$P Q R$ ত্রিভুজে, $P+Q+R=\pi$


ডানপক্ষ $=\sin \frac{P}{2}+\sin \frac{Q}{2}+\sin \frac{R}{2}$


$=1+\sin \frac{P}{2}+\sin \frac{Q}{2}+\sin \frac{R}{2}-1$


$=1+2 \sin \frac{P+Q}{4} \cdot \cos \frac{P-Q}{4}+\sin \frac{R}{2}-\sin \frac{\pi}{2}$


$=1+2 \sin \frac{P+Q}{4} \cdot \cos \frac{P-Q}{4}+2 \cos \frac{R+\pi}{4} \cdot \sin \frac{R-\pi}{4}$


$=1+2 \sin \frac{P+Q}{4} \cdot \cos \frac{P-Q}{4}+2 \cos \frac{2 R+P+Q}{4} \cdot \sin \frac{-P-Q}{4}$


$[\because \mathrm{P}+\mathrm{Q}+\mathrm{R}=\pi]$


$=1+2 \sin \frac{P+Q}{4} \cdot \cos \frac{P-Q}{4}-2 \cos \frac{P+Q+2 R}{4} \cdot \sin \frac{P+Q}{4}$


$ [\because \sin (-\theta)=\sin \theta] $


$ =1+2 \sin \frac{P+Q}{2}\left[\cos \frac{P-Q}{4}-\cos \frac{P+Q+2 R}{4}\right] $


$ =1+2 \sin \frac{P+Q}{4} \cdot 2 \sin \frac{P-Q+P+Q+2 R}{8} \cdot \sin \frac{P+Q+2 R-P+Q}{8} $


$ =1+4 \sin \frac{P+Q}{4} \cdot \sin \frac{P+R}{4} \cdot \sin \frac{Q+R}{4} $


$ =1+4 \cdot \sin \frac{Q+R}{4} \cdot \sin \frac{R+P}{4} \cdot \sin \frac{P+Q}{4} $


= বামপক্ষ


$\therefore 1+4 \cdot \sin \frac{Q+R}{4} \cdot \sin \frac{R+P}{4} \cdot \sin \frac{P+Q}{4}=\sin \frac{P}{2}+\sin \frac{Q}{2}+\sin \frac{R}{2}$ (প্রমাণিত)

questions.question: উদ্দীপক হতত প্রমাণ কর যে, $ \mathrm{p}^{3} \cos (\mathrm{Q}-\mathrm{R})+\mathrm{q}^{3} \cos (\mathrm{R}-\mathrm{P})+\mathrm{r}^{3} \cos (\mathrm{P}-\mathrm{Q})=3 \mathrm{pqr}.$
questions.answer:
$\mathrm{PQR}$ ত্রিভুজে


$ \frac{p}{\sin P}=\frac{q}{\sin Q}=\frac{r}{\sin R} $


এবং $p=q \cos R+r \cos Q$


$q=r \cos P+p \cos R$


$\mathrm{r}=\mathrm{p} \cos \mathrm{Q}+\mathrm{q} \cos \mathrm{P}$


এখন, $\mathrm{P}^{3} \cos (\mathrm{Q}-\mathrm{R})$


$=\mathrm{P}\left\{\mathrm{p}^{2} \cos (\mathrm{Q}-\mathrm{R})\right\}$


$=P\left\{p^{2} \cos Q \cdot \cos R+p^{2} \sin Q \cdot \sin R\right)$


$=P(p \cos Q \cdot p \cos R+p \sin Q \cdot p \sin R)$


$=P\{(r-q \cos P)(q-r \cos P)+q \sin P \cdot r \sin P\}$


$=P\left(q r-q^{2} \cos P-r^{2} \cos P+q r \cos ^{2} P+q r \sin ^{2} P\right)$


$=P\left\{q r-\left(q^{2}+r^{2}\right) \cos P+q r\left(\sin ^{2} P+\cos ^{2} P\right)\right\}$


$=\mathrm{P}\left\{\mathrm{qr}-\left(\mathrm{q}^{2}+\mathrm{r}^{2}\right) \cos \mathrm{P}+\mathrm{qr} .1\right\}$


$=P\left\{2 q r-\left(q^{2}+r^{2}\right) \cos P\right\}$


$=2 \mathrm{pqr}-\mathrm{P}\left(\mathrm{q}^{2}+\mathrm{r}^{2}\right) \cos \mathrm{P}$


অনুরূপভাবে,


$ q^{3} \cos (R-P)=2 p q r-q\left(r^{2}+p^{2}\right) \cdot \cos Q $


এবং $r^{3} \cos (P-Q)=2 p q r-r\left(p^{2}+q^{2}\right) \cos R$


বামপক্ষ $=p^{3} \cdot \cos (Q-R)+q^{3} \cos (R-P)+r^{3} \cos (P-Q)$


$=2 p q r-p\left(q^{2}+r^{2}\right) \cos p+2 p q r-q\left(r^{2}+p^{2}\right) \cos Q$


$=6 p q r-p q^{2} \cos p-r^{2} p \cos p-q r^{2} \cos Q-p^{2} q \cos Q$ $-\mathrm{pp}^{2} \cos R-\mathrm{q}^{2} \mathrm{r} \cos \mathrm{R}$


$=6 p q r-p q(p \cos Q+q \cos P)-q r(q \cos R+r \cos Q)$


$-r p(r \cos P+p \cos R)$


= 6pqr – pq.r – qr.p – rp.q = 6pqr – 3pqr = 3pqr = ডানপক্ষ


$\therefore \mathrm{p}^{3} \cos (\mathrm{Q}-\mathrm{R})+\mathrm{q}^{3} \cos (\mathrm{R}-\mathrm{P})+\mathrm{r}^{3} \cos (\mathrm{P}-\mathrm{Q})=3 \mathrm{pqr}$. (প্রমাণিত)

questions.question: প্রমাণ কর : $\frac{\sin 75^{\circ}+\sin 15^{\circ}}{\sin 75^{\circ}-\sin 15^{\circ}}=\sqrt{3}$.
questions.answer:
বামপক্ষ $=\frac{\sin 75^{\circ}+\sin 15^{\circ}}{\sin 75^{\circ}-\sin 15^{\circ}}$

 

$ =\frac{2 \sin \frac{75^{\circ}+15^{\circ}}{2} \cdot \cos \frac{75^{\circ}-15^{\circ}}{2}}{2 \cos \frac{75^{\circ}+15^{\circ}}{2} \cdot \sin \frac{75^{\circ}-15^{\circ}}{2}} $

 

$ =\frac{\sin 45^{\circ} \cdot \cos 30^{\circ}}{\cos 45^{\circ} \cdot \sin 30^{\circ}} $

 

$ =\tan 45^{\circ} \cdot \cot 30^{\circ} $

 

$ =1 \cdot \sqrt{3}=\sqrt{3} $

 

= ডানপক্ষ

 

$\therefore \quad \frac{\sin 75^{\circ}+\sin 15^{\circ}}{\sin 75^{\circ}-\sin 15^{\circ}}=\sqrt{3}$. (প্রমানিত)

questions.question: প্রমাণ কর : $\sin ^{2} \alpha-\sin ^{2} \beta+\sin ^{2} \gamma=2 \sin \alpha \cos \beta \sin \gamma . \quad 8$
questions.answer:
এখানে, $\triangle P Q R-এ, \alpha+\beta+\gamma=\pi$

 

বামপক্ষ $=\sin ^{2} \alpha-\sin ^{2} \beta+\sin ^{2} \gamma$

 

$=(\sin \alpha+\sin \beta)(\sin \alpha-\sin \beta)+\sin ^{2} \gamma$

 

$=\left(2 \sin \frac{\alpha+\beta}{2} \cos \frac{\alpha-\beta}{2}\right) \cdot\left(2 \cos \frac{\alpha+\beta}{2} \sin \frac{\alpha-\beta}{2}\right)+\sin ^{2} \gamma$

 

$=\left(2 \sin \frac{\alpha+\beta}{2} \cos \frac{\alpha+\beta}{2}\right) \cdot\left(2 \sin \frac{\alpha-\beta}{2} \cos \frac{\alpha-\beta}{2}\right)+\sin ^{2} \gamma$

 

$=\sin (\alpha+\beta) \sin (\alpha-\beta)+\sin ^{2} \gamma$

 

$=\sin (\pi-\gamma) \sin (\alpha-\beta)+\sin ^{2} \gamma[\because \alpha+\beta+\gamma=\pi]$

 

$=\sin \gamma \sin (\alpha-\beta)+\sin ^{2} \gamma$

 

$=\sin \gamma\{\sin (\alpha-\beta)+\sin \gamma\}$

 

$=\sin \gamma[\sin (\alpha-\beta)+\sin \{\pi-(\alpha+\beta)\}][\because \alpha+\beta+\gamma=\pi]$

 

$=\sin \gamma\{\sin (\alpha-\beta)+\sin (\alpha+\beta)\}$

 

$=\sin \gamma \cdot 2 \sin \alpha \cos \beta=2 \sin \alpha \cos \beta \cdot \sin \gamma=$ ডানপক্ষ

 

$\therefore \sin ^{2} \alpha-\sin ^{2} \beta+\sin ^{2} \gamma=2 \sin \alpha \cos \beta \sin \gamma$. (প্রমাণিত)

questions.question: $\cos P=\sin Q-\cos R$ হলে দেখাও যে, $P Q R$ ত্রিভুজটি সমকোণী।
questions.answer:
এখানে, $\triangle P Q R-এ P+Q+R=\pi$

 

এখন, $\cos P=\sin Q-\cos R$ হলে, $\cos P+\cos R=\sin Q$

 

বা, $2 \cos \frac{P+R}{2} \cdot \cos \frac{P-R}{2}=\sin Q$

 

বা, $2 \cos \frac{\pi-Q}{2} \cdot \cos \frac{P-R}{2}=\sin Q \quad[\because P+Q+R=\pi]$

 

বা, $2 \cos \left(\frac{\pi}{2}-\frac{Q}{2}\right) \cdot \cos \frac{P-R}{2}=\sin \left(2 \cdot \frac{Q}{2}\right)$

 

বা, $2 \sin \frac{Q}{2} \cdot \cos \frac{P-R}{2}=2 \sin \frac{Q}{2} \cdot \cos \frac{Q}{2}$

 

বা, $\cos \frac{P-R}{2}=\cos \frac{Q}{2}$

 

বা, $\frac{P-R}{2}=\frac{Q}{2}$

 

বা, $P-R=Q$

 

বা, $P=Q+R$

 

বা, $P=\pi-P \quad[\because P+Q+R=\pi]$

 

বা, $\mathrm{P}+\mathrm{P}=\pi$

 

বা, $2 P=\pi$

 

$\therefore \quad \mathrm{P}=\frac{\pi}{2}$

 

যেহেতু PQR ত্রিভুজের P কোণ সমকোণ।

 

সুতরাং, PQR ত্রিভুজটি সমকোণী। (দেখানো হলো)

questions.question: দেখাও যে, $\sin 29^{\circ}+\cos 29^{\circ}=\sqrt{2} \cos 16^{\circ}$.
questions.answer:
বামপক্ষ, $=\sin 29^{\circ}+\cos 29^{\circ}$


$ =\sin \left(90^{\circ}-61^{\circ}\right)+\cos 29^{\circ} $


$ =\cos 61^{\circ}+\cos 29^{\circ} $


$ =2 \cos \frac{61^{\circ}+29^{\circ}}{2} \cdot \cos \frac{61^{\circ}-29^{\circ}}{2} $


$=2 \cos 45^{\circ} \cdot \cos 16^{\circ}$


$=2 \cdot \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}} \cdot \cos 16^{\circ}$


$=\sqrt{2} \cos 16^{\circ}$


$=$ ডানপক্ষ


$\therefore \sin 29^{\circ}+\cos 29^{\circ}=\sqrt{2} \cos 16^{\circ}$. (দেখানো হলো)

questions.question:
দৃশ্যকল্প-১ এ $ \mathrm{a}^{4}+\mathrm{b}^{4}+\mathrm{c}^{4}=2 \mathrm{~b}^{2}\left(\mathrm{a}^{2}+\mathrm{c}^{2}\right)$ হলে দেখাও যে,

$\angle \mathrm{B}=45^{\circ}$ বা $135^{\circ}$.
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে,


$ a^{4}+b^{4}+c^{4}=2 b^{2}\left(a^{2}+c^{2}\right) $


বা, $a^{4}+b^{4}+c^{4}-2 a^{2} b^{2}-2 b^{2} c^{2}=0$


বা, $a^{4}+b^{4}+c^{4}+2 a^{2} c^{2}-2 b^{2} c^{2}-2 a^{2} b^{2}=2 a^{2} c^{2}$


বা, $\left(a^{2}+c^{2}-b^{2}\right)^{2}=2 a^{2} c^{2}$


বা, $a^{2}+c^{2}-b^{2}= \pm \sqrt{2} a c$


বা, $\frac{a^{2}+c^{2}-b^{2}}{2 a c}= \pm \frac{\sqrt{2} a c}{2 a c}$


বা, $\cos \mathrm{B}= \pm \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\left[\because \triangle \mathrm{ABC}-\mathrm{a} \cos \mathrm{B}=\frac{\mathrm{a}^{2}+\mathrm{c}^{2}-\mathrm{b}^{2}}{2 \mathrm{ac}}\right]$


$\therefore \quad \cos \mathrm{B}=\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}$


বা, $\cos B=\cos 45^{\circ}$


$\therefore \quad B=45^{\circ}$


অথবা, $\cos B=\frac{-1}{\sqrt{2}}$


বা, $\cos \mathrm{B}=\cos 135^{\circ}$


$\therefore \quad B=135^{\circ}$


অতএব, $\angle \mathrm{B}=45^{\circ}$ বা, $135^{\circ}$. (দেখানো হলো)

questions.question: দৃশ্যকল্প-২ হতে প্রমাণ কর যে, $ \cos (\alpha+\beta)=\pm\frac{P}{\sqrt{P^2+Q^2}}.$
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে,


$ \sin 2 \alpha=Q-\sin 2 \beta $


বা, $\sin 2 \alpha+\sin 2 \beta=Q$


বা, $2 \sin (\alpha+\beta) \cdot \cos (\alpha-\beta)=Q$ ......... (i)


এবং $\cos 2 \beta=p-\cos 2 \alpha$


বা, $\cos 2 \alpha+\cos 2 \beta=p$


বা, $2 \cos (\alpha+\beta) \cdot \cos (\hat{\alpha}-\beta)=P$ .......... (ii)


(i)নং কে (ii) নং দ্বারা ভাগ করে পাই,


$ \frac{2 \sin (\alpha+\beta) \cdot \cos (\alpha-\beta)}{2 \cos (\alpha+\beta) \cdot \cos (\alpha-\beta)}=\frac{Q}{P} $


বা, $\tan (\alpha+\beta)=\frac{Q}{P}$


বা, $\tan ^{2}(\alpha+\beta)=\frac{Q^{2}}{P^{2}}$ [বর্গ করে]


বা, $\sec ^{2}(\alpha+\beta)-1=\frac{Q^{2}}{P^{2}}$


বা, $\sec ^{2}(\alpha+\beta)=\frac{Q^{2}}{P^{2}}+1$


বা, $\frac{1}{\cos ^{2}(\alpha+\beta)}=\frac{P^{2}+Q^{2}}{P^{2}}$


বা, $\cos ^{2}(\alpha+\beta)=\frac{P^{2}}{P^{2}+Q^{2}}$


$\therefore \cos (\alpha+\beta)= \pm \frac{\mathrm{P}}{\sqrt{\mathrm{P}^{2}+\mathrm{Q}^{2}}}$. (প্রমাণিত)

questions.question: $\lim _{x \rightarrow 0} \frac{1-\cos x}{2 x^{2}}$ এর মান নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer:
$\lim _{x \rightarrow 0} \frac{1-\cos x}{2 x^{2}}=\lim _{x \rightarrow 0} \frac{2 \sin ^{2} \frac{x}{2}}{2 x^{2}}$


$ =\lim _{x \rightarrow 0} \frac{\sin ^{2} \frac{x}{2}}{x^{2}}=\lim _{x \rightarrow 0} \frac{\sin ^{2} \frac{x}{2}}{4 \cdot\left(\frac{x}{2}\right)^{2}}=\frac{1}{4} \lim _{\frac{x}{2} \rightarrow 0}\left(\frac{\sin \frac{x}{2}}{\frac{x}{2}}\right)^{2}=\frac{1}{4} $


নির্ণেয় মান : $\frac{1}{4}$.

questions.question: $x$ এর কোন মানের জন্য $f(x)$ এর মান সর্বোচ্চ?
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $f(x)=3 x^{3}-6 x^{2}-5 x+2$


$\mathrm{x}$ এর সাপেক্ষে অন্তরীকরণ করে পাই, $f^{\prime}(x)=9 x^{2}-12 x-5$


আবার $\mathrm{x}$ এর সাপেক্ষে অন্তুরীকরণ করে পাই, $f^{\prime \prime}(\mathrm{x})=18 \mathrm{x}-12$


সর্বোচ্চ ও সর্বনিম্ন মানের জন্য,


$ f^{\prime}(x)=0 $


বা, $9 x^{2}-12 x-5=0$


বা, $9 x^{2}-15 x+3 x-5=0$


বা, $9 x^{2}-15 x+3 x-5=0$


বা, $3 x(3 x-5)+1(3 x-5)=0$


বা, $(3 x-5)(3 x+1)=0$


বা, $x=\frac{5}{3}, \frac{-1}{3}$


$x=\frac{5}{3}$ হলে, $f^{\prime \prime}(x)=18 \cdot \frac{5}{3}-12=30-12=18>0$


$\therefore \mathrm{x}=\frac{5}{3}$ এর জন্য $f(\mathrm{x})$ এর মান সর্বনিম্ন


$x=\frac{-1}{3}$ হলে,


$ f^{\prime \prime}(x)=18 \cdot\left(\frac{-1}{3}\right)-12=-6-12=-18<0 $


$\therefore \quad x=\frac{-1}{3}$ এর জন্য $f(x)$ এর মান সর্বোচ্চ।


নির্ণয় মান : $\frac{-1}{3}$.

questions.question: $(-2 ; 5)$ বিন্দুতে $\mathrm{g}(\mathrm{x}, \mathrm{y})=0$ এর স্পর্শকের সমীকরণ নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $\mathrm{g}(\mathrm{x}, \mathrm{y})=\mathrm{x}^{2}+\mathrm{y}^{2}-4 \mathrm{x}-6 \mathrm{y}-7$


এখানে, $g(x, y)=0$


বা, $x^{2}+y^{2}-4 x-6 y-7=0$


$\mathrm{x}$ এর সাপেক্ষে অন্তরীকরণ করে পাই,


$2 x+2 y \frac{d y}{d x}-4-6 \frac{d y}{d x}-0=0$


বা, $(2 y-6) \frac{d y}{d x}=4-2 x$


বা, $2(y-3) \frac{d y}{d x}=2(2-x)$


বা, $(y-3) \frac{d y}{d x}=2-x$


$\therefore \quad \frac{d y}{d x}=\frac{2-x}{y-3}$


$(-2,5)$ বিন্দুতে $\frac{d y}{d x}=\left(\frac{d y}{d x}\right)_{(-2,5)}=\frac{2-(-2)}{5-3}=\frac{4}{2}=2$


$\therefore \quad(-2,5)$ বিন্দুতে স্পর্শকের সমীকরণ,


$ y-y_{1}=\left(\frac{d y}{d x}\right)_{(-2,5)}\left(x-x_{1}\right) $


বা, $y-5=2\{x-(-2)\}$


বা, $y-5=2(x+2)$


বা, $y-5=2 x+4$


$\therefore \quad 2 \mathrm{x}-\mathrm{y}+9=0$


নির্ণেয় স্পর্শকের সমীকরণ, $2 x-y+9=0$.

questions.question: প্রমাণ কর যে, $\cos 5 \theta=16 \cos ^{5} \theta-20 \cos ^{3} \theta+5 \cos \theta$.
questions.answer:
বামপক্ষ $=\cos 5 \theta$


$=\cos (4 \theta+\theta)$


$=\cos 4 \theta \cdot \cos \theta-\sin 4 \theta \cdot \sin \theta$


$=\cos (2 \cdot 2 \theta) \cdot \cos \theta-\sin (2 \cdot 2 \theta) \cdot \sin \theta$


$=\left(2 \cos ^{2} 2 \theta-1\right) \cdot \cos \theta-2 \sin 2 \theta \cdot \cos 2 \theta \cdot \sin \theta$


$=2 \cos ^{2} 2 \theta \cdot \cos \theta-\cos \theta-2 \cdot 2 \sin \theta \cdot \cos \theta \cdot \cos 2 \theta \cdot \sin \theta$


$=2\left(2 \cos ^{2} \theta-1\right)^{2} \cdot \cos \theta-\cos \theta-4 \sin ^{2} \theta \cdot \cos \theta \cdot \cos 2 \theta$


$=2\left(4 \cos ^{4} \theta-4 \cos ^{2} \theta+1\right) \cdot \cos \theta-\cos \theta-4\left(1-\cos ^{2} \theta\right) \cdot \cos \theta \cdot \cos 2 \theta$


$=8 \cos ^{5} \theta-8 \cos ^{3} \theta+2 \cos \theta-\cos \theta-\left(4 \cos \theta-4 \cos ^{3} \theta\right) \cdot\left(2 \cos ^{2} \theta-1\right)$


$=8 \cos ^{5} \theta-8 \cos ^{3} \theta+\cos \theta-\left(8 \cos ^{3} \theta-4 \cos \theta-8 \cos ^{5} \theta+4 \cos ^{3} \theta\right)$


$=8 \cos ^{5} \theta-8 \cos ^{3} \theta+\cos \theta-8 \cos ^{3} \theta+4 \cos \theta+8 \cos ^{5} \theta-4 \cos ^{3} \theta$


$=16 \cos ^{5} \theta-20 \cos ^{3} \theta+5 \cos \theta$


$=$ ডানপক্ষ


$\therefore \quad \cos 5 \theta=16 \cos ^{5} \theta-20 \cos ^{3} \theta+5 \cos \theta$. (প্রমাণিত)

questions.question: উদ্দীপকের আলোকে দেখাও যে, $\cos (B+C)+\cos (C+A) +\cos (\mathrm{A}+\mathrm{B})=1+4 \sin \frac{\pi-2 \mathrm{~A}}{4} \sin \frac{\pi-2 \mathrm{~B}}{4} \sin \frac{\pi-2 \mathrm{C}}{4} \cdot 8$
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $\mathrm{A}+\mathrm{B}+\mathrm{C}=\frac{\pi}{2}$


বামপক্ষ $=\cos (\mathrm{B}+\mathrm{C})+\cos (\mathrm{C}+\mathrm{A})+\cos (\mathrm{A}+\mathrm{B})$


$=\cos \left(\frac{\pi}{2}-\mathrm{A}\right)+\cos \left(\frac{\pi}{2}-\mathrm{B}\right)+\cos \left(\frac{\pi}{2}-\mathrm{C}\right)$


$=\sin \mathrm{A}+\sin \mathrm{B}+\sin \mathrm{C}$


$\left[\because \mathrm{A}+\mathrm{B}+\mathrm{C}=\frac{\pi}{2}\right]$


$=1+2 \sin \frac{\mathrm{A}+\mathrm{B}}{2} \cdot \cos \frac{\mathrm{A}-\mathrm{B}}{2}+\sin \mathrm{C}-1$


$=1+2 \sin \frac{\mathrm{A}+\mathrm{B}}{2} \cdot \cos \frac{\mathrm{A}-\mathrm{B}}{2}+\sin \mathrm{C}-\sin \frac{\pi}{2}$


$=1+2 \sin \frac{A+B}{2} \cdot \cos \frac{A-B}{2}+\sin C-\sin (A+B+C)$


$\left[\because A+B+C=\frac{\pi}{2}\right]$


$=1+2 \sin \frac{A+B}{2} \cdot \cos \frac{A-B}{2}+2 \cos \frac{C+A+B+C}{2} \cdot \sin \frac{C-A-B-C}{2}$


$=1+2 \sin \frac{A+B}{2} \cdot \cos \frac{A-B}{2}+2 \cos \frac{A+B+2 C}{2} \cdot \sin \left\{-\left(\frac{A+B}{2}\right)\right\}$


$=1+2 \sin \frac{A+B}{2} \cdot \cos \frac{A-B}{2}-2 \cos \frac{A+B+2 C}{2} \cdot \sin \frac{A+B}{2}$


$=1+2 \sin \frac{A+B}{2}\left[\cos \frac{A-B}{2}-\cos \frac{A+B+2 C}{2}\right]$


$=1+2 \sin \frac{A+B}{2} \cdot 2 \sin \frac{A-B+A+B+2 C}{4} \cdot \sin \frac{A+B+2 C-A+B}{4}$


$=1+4 \sin \frac{A+B}{2} \cdot \sin \frac{A+C}{2} \cdot \sin \frac{B+C}{2}$


$=1+4 \sin \frac{\frac{\pi}{2}-\mathrm{C}}{2} \cdot \sin \frac{\frac{\pi}{2}-\mathrm{B}}{2} \cdot \sin \frac{\frac{\pi}{2}-\mathrm{A}}{2}\left[\because \mathrm{A}+\mathrm{B}+\mathrm{C}=\frac{\pi}{2}\right]$


$=1+4 \sin \frac{\pi-2 \mathrm{C}}{4} \cdot \sin \frac{\pi-\mathrm{B}}{4} \cdot \sin \frac{\pi-2 \mathrm{~A}}{4}$


$=1+4 \sin \frac{\pi-2 \mathrm{~A}}{4} \cdot \sin \frac{\pi-2 \mathrm{~B}}{4} \cdot \sin \frac{\pi-2 \mathrm{C}}{4}$


= বামপক্ষ


$\therefore \quad \cos (\mathrm{B}+\mathrm{C})+\cos (\mathrm{C}+\mathrm{A})+\cos (\mathrm{A}+\mathrm{B})$


$=1+4 \sin \frac{\pi-2 A}{4} \cdot \sin \frac{\pi-2 B}{4} \cdot \sin \frac{\pi-2 C}{4}$. (দেখানো হলো)

questions.question: উদ্দীপকের আলোকে যদি $\tan A+\tan B+\tan C=\sqrt{3}$ হয়, তবে প্রমাণ কর যে, $\mathrm{A}=\mathbf{B}=\mathbf{C}$.
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $\mathrm{A}+\mathrm{B}+\mathrm{C}=\frac{\pi}{2}$


বা, $\mathrm{A}+\mathrm{B}=\frac{\pi}{2}-\mathrm{C}$


বা, $\tan (A+B)=\tan \left(\frac{\pi}{2}-C\right)$


বা, $\frac{\tan A+\tan B}{1-\tan A \cdot \tan B}=\cot C$


বা, $\frac{\tan A+\tan B}{1-\tan A \cdot \tan B}=\frac{1}{\tan C}$


বা, $\tan A \cdot \tan C+\tan B \cdot \tan C=1-\tan A \cdot \tan B$


বা, $\tan \mathrm{A} \cdot \tan \mathrm{C}+\tan \mathrm{B} \cdot \tan \mathrm{C}+\tan \mathrm{A} \cdot \tan \mathrm{B}=1$ .......... (i)


আবার, $\tan A+\tan B+\tan C=\sqrt{3}$


বা, $(\tan A+\tan B+\tan C)^{2}=(\sqrt{3})^{2}$ [বর্গ করে]


বা, $\tan ^{2} \mathrm{~A}+\tan ^{2} \mathrm{~B}+\tan ^{2} \mathrm{C}+2(\tan \mathrm{A} \cdot \tan \mathrm{B}+\tan \mathrm{B} \cdot \tan \mathrm{C}$ $+\tan C \cdot \tan A)=3$


বা, $\tan ^{2} \mathrm{~A}+\tan ^{2} \mathrm{~B}+\tan ^{2} \mathrm{C}+2.1=3$ [(i) নং হতে মান বসিয়ে ]


বা, $\tan ^{2} \mathrm{~A}+\tan ^{2} \mathrm{~B}+\tan ^{2} \mathrm{C}-1=0$


বা, $2 \tan ^{2} \mathrm{~A}+2 \tan ^{2} \mathrm{~B}+2 \tan ^{2} \mathrm{C}-2=0$


বা, $2 \tan ^{2} \mathrm{~A}+2 \tan ^{2} \mathrm{~B}+2 \tan ^{2} \mathrm{C}-2(\tan \mathrm{A} \cdot \tan \mathrm{B}+\tan \mathrm{B} \cdot \tan \mathrm{C} +\tan C \cdot \tan A)=0 $


বা, $\tan ^{2} \mathrm{~A}-2 \tan \mathrm{A} \cdot \tan \mathrm{B}+\tan ^{2} \mathrm{~B}+\tan ^{2} \mathrm{~B}-2 \tan \mathrm{B} \cdot \tan \mathrm{C} +\tan ^{2} C+\tan ^{2} C-2 \tan C \cdot \tan A+\tan ^{2} A=0 $


বা, $(\tan A-\tan B)^{2}+(\tan B-\tan C)^{2}+(\tan C-\tan A)^{2}=0$ একাধিক বর্গের যোগফল শূন্য হলে তারা প্রত্যেকে পৃথকভাবে শূন্য হয়।


$\therefore \tan A-\tan B=0, \tan B-\tan C=0$ এবং $\tan C-\tan A=0$


বা, $\tan A=\tan B$ বা, $\tan B=\tan C$ বা, $\tan C=\tan A$


বা, $\mathrm{A}=\mathrm{B} \quad$ বা, $\mathrm{B}=\mathrm{C} \quad$ বা,  $\mathrm{C}=\mathrm{A}$


অতএব, $A=B=C$. (প্রমাণিত)

questions.question: কোনো ত্রিভুজের বাহুগুলির দৈর্ঘ্য 3a, 5a ও 7a একক হলে ত্রিভুজটির বৃহত্তম কোণ নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer:
ধরি, $\triangle P Q R$ এর বাহুগুলো $p, q, r$ এবং $p=3 a, q=5 a, r=7 a$


$\because r$ বাহু বৃহত্তম।


$\therefore \angle \mathrm{R}$ বৃহত্তম।


$\cos R=\frac{p^{2}+q^{2}-r^{2}}{2 p q}$


$ =\frac{(3 a)^{2}+(5 a)^{2}-(7 a)^{2}}{2 \cdot 3 a \cdot 5 a} $


$ =\frac{9 a^{2}+25 a^{2}-49 a^{2}}{30 a^{2}}=\frac{-15 a^{2}}{30 a^{2}}=\frac{-1}{2} $


বা, $\operatorname{cor} R=\frac{-1}{2}$


বা, $\cos R=\cos 120^{\circ}$


$\therefore \quad R=120^{\circ}$


নির্ণেয় ত্রিভুজের বৃহত্তম কোণ $120^{\circ}$.

questions.question: $\varphi(2 x) \varphi(4 x) \varphi(8 x) \varphi(14 x)$ এর মান নির্ণয় কর, যখন $x=\frac{\pi}{15} .$
questions.answer:
$\varphi(x)=\cos x$


$\varphi(4 x)=\cos 4 x$


$\varphi(8 x)=\cos 8 x$


$\varphi(14 \mathrm{x})=\cos 14 \mathrm{x}$


প্রদত্ত রাশি $=\varphi(2 x) \cdot \varphi(4 x) \cdot \varphi(8 x) \cdot \varphi(14 x)$


$=\cos 2 \mathrm{x} \cdot \cos 4 \mathrm{x} \cdot \cos 8 \mathrm{x} \cdot \cos 14 \mathrm{x}$


$=\frac{1}{2 \sin 2 x}(2 \sin 2 x \cdot \cos 2 x) \cdot \cos 4 x \cdot \cos 8 x \cdot \cos 14 x$


$=\frac{1}{2 \sin 2 x} \sin 4 x \cdot \cos 4 x \cdot \cos 8 x \cdot \cos 14 x$


$=\frac{1}{4 \sin 2 x} \cdot 2 \sin 4 x \cos 4 x \cdot \cos 8 x \cdot \cos 14 x$


$=\frac{1}{4 \sin 2 x} \cdot \sin 8 x \cdot \cos 8 x \cdot \cos 14 x$


$=\frac{1}{8 \sin 2 x} \cdot 2 \sin 8 x \cdot \cos 8 x \cdot \cos 14 x$


$=\frac{1}{8 \sin 2 x} \cdot \sin 16 x \cdot \cos 14 x$


$=\frac{1}{16 \sin 2 x} \cdot 2 \sin 16 x \cdot \cos 14 x$


$=\frac{1}{16 \sin 2 x}\{\sin (16 x+14 x)+\sin (16 x-14 x)\}$


$=\frac{1}{16 \sin 2 x}(\sin 30 x+\sin 2 x)$


$=\frac{1}{16 \sin \frac{2 \pi}{15}}\left(\sin 2 \pi+\sin \frac{2 \pi}{15}\right)\left[\because x=\frac{\pi}{15}\right]$


$=\frac{1}{16 \sin \frac{2 \pi}{15}}\left(0+\sin \frac{2 \pi}{15}\right)=\frac{1}{16}$


নির্ণেয় মান : $\frac{1}{16}$

questions.question:
$p \varphi(x)+q \varphi(y)=r=p \varphi\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-x\right)+q \varphi\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-y\right)$ হলে,


দেখাও যে, $\varphi\left(\frac{x-y}{2}\right)= \pm \sqrt{\frac{2 r^{2}-(p-q)^{2}}{4 p q}}$
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে,


$ \varphi(x)=\cos x $


$\therefore \varphi(y)=\cos y$.


$\varphi\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-x\right)=\cos \left(\frac{\pi}{2}-x\right)=\sin x$


$\varphi\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-y\right)=\cos \left(\frac{\pi}{2}-y\right)=\sin y$


$\varphi\left(\frac{x-y}{2}\right)=\cos \left(\frac{x-y}{2}\right)$


আবার, $p \varphi(x)+q \varphi(y)=r$


বা, $p \cos x+q \cos y=r \ldots \ldots \ldots \ldots .$. (i)


এবং $p \varphi\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-x\right)+q \varphi\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-y\right)=r$


বা, $p \sin x+q \sin y=r \ldots \ldots \ldots \ldots \ldots \ldots$ (ii)


(i) নং এবং (ii)নং কে বর্গ কটে যোগ করি,


$p^{2} \cos ^{2} x+2 p q \cos x \cdot \cos y+q^{2} \cos ^{2} y+p^{2} \sin ^{2} x$ $+2 p q \sin x \cdot \sin y+q^{2} \sin ^{2} y=r^{2}+r^{2}$


বা, $p^{2}\left(\cos ^{2} x+\sin ^{2} x\right)+2 p q(\cos x \cdot \cos y+\sin x \cdot \sin y) +2 p q \sin x \cdot \sin y+q^2 \sin ^2 y=r^2+r^2$


বা, $p^{2}+2 p q \cos (x-y)+q^{2}=2 r^{2} +q^{2}\left(\cos ^{2} y+\sin ^{2} y\right)=2 r^{2} $


বা, $2 p q \cos (x-y)=2 r^{2}-p^{2}-q^{2}$


বা, $\cos (x-y)=\frac{2 r^{2}-p^{2}-q^{2}}{2 p q}$


বা, $\cos \left(2 . \frac{x-y}{2}\right)=\frac{2 r^{2}-p^{2}-q^{2}}{2 p q}$


বা, $2 \cos ^{2} \frac{x-y}{2}-1=\frac{2 r^{2}-p^{2}-q^{2}}{2 p q}$


বা, $2 \cos ^{2} \frac{x-y}{2}=\frac{2 r^{2}-p^{2}-q^{2}}{2 p q}+1$


বা, $2 \cos ^{2} \frac{x-y}{2}=\frac{2 r^{2}-p^{2}-q^{2}+2 p q}{2 p q}$


বা, $\cos ^{2} \frac{x-y}{2}=\frac{2 r^{2}-\left(p^{2}-2 p q+q^{2}\right)}{4 p q}$


বা, $\cos \frac{x-y}{2}= \pm \sqrt{\frac{2 r^{2}-(p-q)^{2}}{4 p q}}$


$\therefore \quad \varphi\left(\frac{x-y}{2}\right)= \pm \sqrt{\frac{2 r^{2}-(p-q)^{2}}{4 p q}} \cdot($ দেখানো হলো)

questions.question: $\tan \theta=\frac{3}{4}$ এবং $\pi<\theta<\frac{3 \pi}{2}$ হলে, $\operatorname{cosec}(-\theta)+\sec (-\theta)$ এর মান নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer:
$\tan \theta=\frac{3}{4}$


$\pi<\theta<\frac{3 \pi}{2}$


অর্থাৎ, $\theta$ এর অবস্থান ৩য় চতুর্ভাগে


$\therefore \quad \operatorname{cosec} \theta=-\frac{5}{3}$ এবং $\sec \theta=-\frac{5}{4}$


প্রদত্ত রাশি $=\operatorname{cosec}(-\theta)+\sec (-\theta)$


$ =-\operatorname{cosec} \theta+\sec \theta $


$ =-\left(-\frac{5}{3}\right)+\left(-\frac{5}{4}\right)=\frac{5}{3}-\frac{5}{4}=\frac{20-15}{12}=\frac{5}{12} $


নির্ণেয় মান : $\frac{5}{12}$.

questions.question: $f(\alpha)+f(\beta)=\mathrm{a}$ এবং $f\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-\alpha\right)+f\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-\beta\right)=\mathrm{b}$ হলে, প্রমাণ কর যে, $\sin \frac{\alpha+\beta}{2}= \pm \frac{b}{\sqrt{a^{2}+b^{2}}}$.
questions.answer:
দৃশ্যকল্প-১ হতে,


$f(x)=\cos x$


$\therefore \quad f(\alpha)=\cos \alpha$


$f(\beta)=\cos \beta$


$f\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-\alpha\right)=\cos \left(\frac{\pi}{2}-\alpha\right)=\sin \alpha$


$f\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-\beta\right)=\cos \left(\frac{\pi}{2}-\beta\right)=\sin \beta$


আবার, $f(\alpha)+f(\beta)=\mathrm{a}$


বা, $\cos \alpha+\cos \beta=a$


বা, $2 \cos \frac{\alpha+\beta}{2} \cdot \cos \frac{\alpha-\beta}{2}=a$ ...... (i)


এবং $f\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-\alpha\right)+f\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-\beta\right)=b$


বা, $\sin \alpha+\sin \beta=b$


বা, $2 \sin \frac{\alpha+\beta}{2} \cdot \cos \frac{\alpha-\beta}{2}=b$ ...... (ii)


(i)নং কে (ii)নং দ্বারা ভাগ করে পাই,


$\frac{2 \cos \frac{\alpha+\beta}{2} \cdot \cos \frac{\alpha-\beta}{2}}{2 \sin \frac{\alpha+\beta}{2} \cdot \cos \frac{\alpha-\beta}{2}}=\frac{a}{b}$


বা, $\cot \frac{\alpha+\beta}{2}=\frac{a}{b}$


বা, $\cot ^{2} \frac{\alpha+\beta}{2}=\frac{a^{2}}{b^{2}}$ [বর্গ করে]


বা, $\operatorname{cosec}^{2} \frac{\alpha+\beta}{2}-1=\frac{a^{2}}{b^{2}}$


বা, $\operatorname{cosec}^{2} \frac{\alpha+\beta}{2}=\frac{a^{2}}{b^{2}}+1$


বা, $\operatorname{cosec}^{2} \frac{\alpha+\beta}{2}=\frac{a^{2}+b^{2}}{b^{2}}$


বা, $\frac{1}{\operatorname{cosec}^{2} \frac{\alpha+\beta}{2}}=\frac{1}{\frac{a^{2}+b^{2}}{b^{2}}}$


বা, $\sin ^{2} \frac{\alpha+\beta}{2}=\frac{b^{2}}{a^{2}+b^{2}}$


$\therefore \sin \frac{\alpha+\beta}{2}= \pm \frac{b}{\sqrt{a^{2}+b^{2}}}$. (প্রমাণিত)

questions.question: $A B C$ ত্রিভূজ হতে, $\sin ^2 A+\sin ^2 B+\sin ^2 C-2 \cos A \cos B \cos C$ এর মান নির্ণয় কর।

questions.question: মূল নিয়মে x এর সাপেক্ষে $\frac{1}{f(3 x)}$ এর অন্তরজ নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, f(x)=sin⁡x


$\begin{aligned} \therefore & f(3 x)=\sin 3 x \\ \therefore & \frac{1}{f(3 x)}=\frac{1}{\sin 3 x}=\operatorname{cosec} 3 x \\ & \therefore \frac{1}{f\{3(x+h)\}}=\frac{1}{\sin \{3(x+h)\}}=\frac{1}{\sin (3 x+3 h)}=\operatorname{cosec}(3 x+3 h \\ & \therefore \frac{d}{d x}\left\{\frac{1}{f(3 x)}\right\}=\lim _{h \rightarrow 0} \frac{\frac{1}{f\{3(x+h)\}}-\frac{1}{f(3 x)}}{h} \\ & =\lim _{h \rightarrow 0} \frac{\operatorname{cosec}(3 x+3 h)-\operatorname{cosec} 3 x}{h} \\ & =\lim _{h \rightarrow 0} \frac{1}{\sin (3 x+3 h)} \frac{1}{\sin 3 x} \\ & =\lim _{h \rightarrow 0} \frac{1}{h} \times \frac{\sin 3 x-\sin (3 x+3 h)}{\sin 3 x \cdot \sin (3 x+3 h)} \\ & =\lim _{h \rightarrow 0} \frac{1}{h} \times \frac{2 \cos \left(3 x+\frac{3 h}{2}\right)}{\sin 3 x \cdot \sin \left(-\frac{3 h}{2}\right)} \\ & =-2 \lim _{h \rightarrow 0}\left(\frac{\sin \frac{34}{2}}{\frac{34}{2}}\right) \times \frac{3}{2} \times \lim _{h \rightarrow 0} \frac{\cos \left(3 x+\frac{3 h}{2}\right)}{\cos 3 x \cdot \sin (3 x+34)} \\ & =-2 \times \frac{3}{2} \times \frac{\cos 3 x}{\sin 3 x \cdot \sin 3 x} \\ & =-3 \cot 3 x \cdot \operatorname{cosec} 3 x \\ & \therefore \frac{d}{d x}\{f(3 x)\}=-3 \cdot \operatorname{cosec} 3 x \cdot \cot 3 x\end{aligned}$

questions.question: $y=f\left(a_{\sin ^{-1}} x\right)$ হলে দেখাও যে, $\left(1-x^2\right) \frac{d^2 y}{d x^2}-x \frac{d y}{d x}+a^2 y=0$
questions.answer:
$\begin{aligned} & f(x)=\sin x \\ & \therefore f\left(a \sin ^{-1} x\right)=\sin \left(a \sin ^{-2} x\right) \\ \Rightarrow & y=\sin \left(a \sin ^{-1} x\right) \\ \Rightarrow & y_1=\cos \left(a \sin ^{-1} x\right) \times \frac{a}{\sqrt{1-x^2}} \\ \Rightarrow & \left(\sqrt{1-x^2}\right) y_1=a \cos \left(a \sin ^{-1} x\right) \\ \Rightarrow & \left(1-x^2\right) y_1^2=a^2 \cos ^2\left(a \sin ^{-1} x\right) \\ \Rightarrow & \left(1-x^2\right) y_1^2=a^2\left\{1-\sin ^2\left(a \sin ^{-1} x\right)\right\} \\ \Rightarrow & \left(1-x^2\right) y_1^2=a^2-a^2 \sin ^2\left(a \sin ^2 x\right) \\ \Rightarrow & \left(1-x^2\right) y_1^2=a^2-a^2 y^2 \\ \Rightarrow & \left(1-x^2\right) 2 y_1 y_2+y_1^2(0-2 x)=0-a^2: 2 y y_1 \\ \Rightarrow & \left(1-x^2\right) 2 y_1 y_2-2 x y_1^2=-2 a^2 y_1 \\ \Rightarrow & \left(1-x^2\right) y_2-x y_1+a^2 y=0 \\ \therefore & \left(1-x^2\right) \frac{d^2 y}{d x^2}-x \frac{d y}{d x}+a^2 y=0 \end{aligned}$


(দেখানো হলো)

questions.question: $a=\sqrt{3}+1, b=\sqrt{3}-1, C=60^{\circ}$ হলে, $\Delta$ ABC-এ c বাহুর দৈর্ঘ্য নির্ণয় কর।

$\Rightarrow \cos 60^{\circ}=\frac{(\sqrt{3}+1)^2+(\sqrt{3}-1)^2-c^2}{2(\sqrt{3}+1)(\sqrt{3}-1)} $

$\Rightarrow \frac{1}{2}=\frac{2\left\{(\sqrt{3})^2+1\right\}-c}{2\left[(\sqrt{3})^2-1^2\right]} $

$ \Rightarrow \frac{1}{4}=\frac{2 \times 4-c^2}{2 \times 2} $

$\Rightarrow 2=8-c^2 $

$\therefore C=\sqrt{6} $ (Ans)

$\begin{aligned}& f(x)=\sin x \\& \mathrm{~L} \cdot \mathrm{H} \cdot \mathrm{s}=\mathrm{f}(\mathrm{A}+\mathrm{B}-\mathrm{C})+\mathrm{f}(\mathrm{B}+\mathrm{C}-\mathrm{A})+\mathrm{f}(\mathrm{C}+\mathrm{A}-\mathrm{B}) \\&= \sin (\mathrm{A}+\mathrm{B}-\mathrm{C})+\sin (\mathrm{B}+\mathrm{C}-\mathrm{A})+\sin (\mathrm{C}+\mathrm{A}-\mathrm{B}) \\&= \sin (\pi-2 \mathrm{C})+\sin (1 \pm 2 \mathrm{~A})+\sin (\mathrm{H}-2 \mathrm{~B}) \\&= \sin 2 \mathrm{C}+\sin 2 \mathrm{~A}+\sin 2 \mathrm{~B} \\&= 2 \sin (2 \mathrm{C}+2 \mathrm{~A}) \cdot \cos \left(\frac{2 \mathrm{C}-2 \mathrm{~A}}{2}\right)+\sin 2 \mathrm{~B} \\&= 2 \sin (\mathrm{C}+\mathrm{A}) \cdot \cos (\mathrm{C}-\mathrm{A})+\sin 2 \mathrm{~B} \\ &= 2 \sin (\pi-\mathrm{B}) \cdot \cos (\mathrm{C}-\mathrm{A})+\sin 2 \mathrm{~B} \\ &= 2 \sin \mathrm{B} \cdot \cos (\mathrm{C}-\mathrm{A})+2 \sin \mathrm{B} \cdot \cos \mathrm{B} \\ &= 2 \sin \mathrm{B}[\cos (\mathrm{C}-\mathrm{A})+\cos \mathrm{B}] \\ &= 2 \sin \mathrm{B}[\cos (\mathrm{C}-\mathrm{A})+\cos (\mathrm{H}-(\mathrm{C}+\mathrm{A})] \\ &= 2 \sin \mathrm{B}[-\cos (\mathrm{C}+\mathrm{A})+\cos (\mathrm{C}-\mathrm{A}] \\ &= 2 \sin \mathrm{B}[\cos (\mathrm{C}-\mathrm{A})-\cos (\mathrm{C}+\mathrm{A}] \\ &= 2 \sin \mathrm{B} \cdot 2 \sin \mathrm{C} \cdot \sin \mathrm{A} \\ &= 4 \sin \mathrm{A} \cdot \sin \mathrm{B} \cdot \sin \mathrm{C} \end{aligned}$

$ =\frac{1}{2} \left(2 \cos \frac{2 A+2 C}{2} \cos \frac{2 A-2 C}{2}\right)+\cos ^{2} B $

$ =-\cos B[\cos (A-C)+\cos (A+C)] $

 

$=-\cos B \times 2 \cos A \cos C$

 

$=-2 \cos A \cos B \cos C$

$=0$

এখন,

 

বামপক্ষ $=\sin ^{2} \alpha+\sin ^{2} \beta+\sin ^{2} \gamma+2 \sin \alpha \sin \beta \sin \gamma$

$=1-\cos (\alpha+\beta) \cos (\alpha-\beta)+\sin ^{2} \gamma+2 \sin \alpha \sin \beta \sin \gamma$

$=1$ = ডানপক্ষ

questions.question: দৃশ্যকল্প-২ থেকে প্রমাণ কর যে, $\sin \frac{1}{2}(x-y)= \pm \frac{1}{2} \sqrt{4-a^2-b^2}$
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $\sin \mathrm{x}=\mathrm{a}-\sin \mathrm{y}$


ব, $a=\sin x+\sin y$


$\therefore \mathrm{a}=2 \sin \frac{\mathrm{x}+\mathrm{y}}{2} \cdot \cos \frac{\mathrm{x}-\mathrm{y}}{2} ...... (1) $


এবং $\cos x=b-\cos y$


বা, $\mathrm{b}=\cos \mathrm{x}+\cos \mathrm{y}$


$\therefore \mathrm{b}=2 \cos \frac{\mathrm{x}+\mathrm{y}}{2} \cdot \cos \frac{\mathrm{x}-\mathrm{y}}{2} ...... (2) $


সমীকরণ (1) ও (2) নং কে বর্গ করে যোগ করি,


$a^2+b^2=4 \sin ^2 \frac{x+y}{2} \cdot \cos ^2 \frac{x-y}{2}+4 \cos ^2 \frac{x-y}{2} \cdot \cos ^2 \frac{x-y}{2}$


বাা, $a^2+b^2=4 \cos ^2 \frac{x-y}{2}\left(\sin ^2 \frac{x+y}{2}+\cos ^2 \frac{x+y}{2}\right)$


বা, $\frac{a^2+b^2}{4}=\cos ^2 \frac{x-y}{2} .1$


বা, $\frac{a^2+b^2}{4}=1-\sin ^2 \frac{x-y}{2}$


বা, $\sin ^2 \frac{x-y}{2}=1-\frac{a^2+b^2}{4}$


বা, $\sin ^2 \frac{x-y}{2}=1-\frac{a^2+b^2}{4}$


বা, $\sin ^2 \frac{x-y}{2}=\frac{1}{4}\left(4-a^2-b^2\right)$


$\therefore \sin \frac{1}{2}(\mathrm{x}-\mathrm{y})= \pm \frac{1}{2} \sqrt{4-\mathrm{a}^2-\mathrm{b}^2} \quad$ (প্রমাণিত)

$ A B=c $

$\therefore \cos A=\frac{b^2+c^2-a^2}{2 b c}$

নির্ণেয় ত্রিভূজটির সূক্ষ্মকোণদ্বয়ের সমষ্টি $60^{\circ}$

questions.question: ত্রিভুজটির ক্ষেত্রে প্রমাণ কর যে, $\frac{a-b}{c} \operatorname{cosec} \frac{A-B}{2}=\sec \frac{c}{2}$

$ =\frac{\sin A-\sin B}{\sin C} \times \frac{1}{\sin \frac{A-B}{2}} $

$ =\frac{\cos \frac{180^{\circ}-C}{2}}{\sin \frac{C}{2}} \sec \frac{C}{2} $


$ =\frac{\sin \frac{C}{2}}{\sin \frac{C}{2}} \sec \frac{C}{2}=\sec \frac{C}{2}= $ ডানপক্ষ


$ \therefore \frac{a-b}{c} \operatorname{cosec} \frac{A-B}{2}=\sec \frac{C}{2} $ (প্রমাণিত)

questions.question: প্রমাণ কর যে, $g(2 y)+g(2 x)=g(x-y) g(x+y)$.

$ =\left(e^{2 x}+e^{-2 x}\right)+\left(e^{2 y}+e^{-2 y}\right) $


$ =\mathrm{g}(2 \mathrm{y})+\mathrm{g}(2 \mathrm{x}) $


= বামপক্ষ


$\therefore \mathrm{g}(2 \mathrm{y})+\mathrm{g}(2 \mathrm{x})=\mathrm{g}(\mathrm{x}-\mathrm{y}) \mathrm{g}(\mathrm{x}+\mathrm{y}) $ (প্রমাণিত)

questions.question: যদি $\mathrm{A}=\mathbb{R}-\left\{-\frac{1}{2}\right\}, \mathrm{B}=\mathbb{R}-\left\{\frac{1}{2}\right\}$ এবং $f: \mathrm{A} \rightarrow$ B- তে সংজ্ঞায়িত হয়, তবে দেখাও যে, $f(\mathrm{x})$ একটি এক-এক ফাংশন এবং $f^{-1}$ নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $f(x)=\frac{5 x-3}{2 x+1}, f: A \rightarrow B$

 

এবং, $A=\mathbb{R}-\left\{-\frac{1}{2}\right\}, B=\mathbb{R}-\left\{\frac{1}{2}\right\}$

 

ধরি, $\mathrm{x}_1, \mathrm{x}_2 \in \mathbb{R}$ এবং $\mathrm{x}_1 \neq \mathrm{x}_2$

 

তাহলে, $f\left(\mathrm{x}_1\right)=f\left(\mathrm{x}_2\right)$

 

বা, $\frac{5 x_1-3}{2 x_1+1}=\frac{5 x_2-3}{2 x_2+1}$

 

বা, $10 \mathrm{x}_1 \mathrm{x}_2-6 \mathrm{x}_1+5 \mathrm{x}_2-3=10 \mathrm{x}_1 \mathrm{x}_2$

 

$-6 x_2+5 x_1-3$

 

বা, $5 x_2+6 x_2=5 x_1+6 x_1$

 

বা, $11 x_1=11 x_2$

 

বা, $x_1=x_2$

 

$\therefore f(x)$ একটি এক-এক ফাংশন।

 

এখন, ধরি, $y=\frac{5 x-3}{2 x+1}$

 

বা, $2 x y+y=5 x-3$

 

বা, $x(2 y-5)=-y-3$

 

বা, $\mathrm{x}=\frac{y+3}{5-2 y}$

 

বা, $f^{-1}(y)=\frac{y+3}{5-2 y}[f(x)=y]$

 

$\therefore f^{-1}(x)=\frac{x+3}{5-2 x}$

questions.question: $X=Y$ হলে, দেখাও যে, $2(\alpha+\beta)=\pi$
questions.answer:
এখানে, $X=\sin \alpha-\cos \alpha$ এবং $Y=\cos \beta-\sin \beta \mathrm{X}=\mathrm{Y}$ হলে, $\sin \alpha-\cos \alpha=\cos \beta-\sin \beta$

 

বা, $\sin \alpha+\sin \beta=\cos \alpha+\cos \beta$


বা, $2 \sin \frac{\alpha+\beta}{2} \cos \frac{\alpha-\beta}{2}=2 \cos \frac{\alpha+\beta}{2} \cos \frac{\alpha-\beta}{2}$


বা, $\sin \frac{\alpha+\beta}{2}=\cos \frac{\alpha+\beta}{2}$


বা, $\tan \frac{\alpha+\beta}{2}=\tan \frac{\pi}{4}$


বা, $\frac{\alpha+\beta}{2}=\frac{\pi}{4}$


বা, $\alpha+\beta=\frac{\pi}{2}$


$\therefore 2(\alpha+\beta)=\pi$. (দেখানো হলো)

questions.question: প্রমাণ কর যে, $P+\sqrt{3} Q=4 \tan 50^{\circ}$.
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে,


$ P=\operatorname{cosec} 20^{\circ} $ এবং $ Q=\sec 20^{\circ} $


বামপক $ =\mathbf{P}+\sqrt{3} Q $


$ =\operatorname{cosec} 20^{\circ}+\sqrt{3} \sec 20^{\circ} $


$ =\frac{1}{\sin 20^{\circ}}+\frac{\sqrt{3}}{\cos 20^{\circ}} $


$ =\frac{1}{\sin 20^{\circ}}+\frac{\tan 60^{\circ}}{\cos 20^{\circ}} $


$ =\frac{1}{\sin 20^{\circ}}+\frac{\sin 60^{\circ}}{\cos 20^{\circ} \cos 60^{\circ}} $


$ =\frac{\cos 60^{\circ} \cos 20^{\circ}+\sin 60^{\circ} \sin 20^{\circ}}{\cos 60^{\circ} \sin 20^{\circ} \cos 20^{\circ}} $


$ =\frac{\cos \left(60^{\circ}-20^{\circ}\right)}{\frac{1}{2} \sin 20^{\circ} \cos 20^{\circ}} $


$ =\frac{\cos 40^{\circ}}{\frac{1}{4} \times 2 \sin 20^{\circ} \cos 20^{\circ}} $


$ =\frac{4 \cos 40^{\circ}}{\sin 40^{\circ}} $


$ =4 \cot 40^{\circ}=4 \cot \left(90^{\circ}-50^{\circ}\right)=4 \tan 50^{\circ}= $  ডানপক্ষ

questions.question: $\sin 25^{\circ}+\cos 25^{\circ}$ এর মান কত?
questions.answer: $\begin{aligned} & \sin 25^{\circ}+\cos 25^{\circ}=\sin 25^{\circ}+\cos \left(90^{\circ}-65^{\circ}\right) \\ & =\sin 25^{\circ}+\sin 65^{\circ} \\ & =2 \sin \frac{65^{\circ}+25^{\circ}}{2} \cos \frac{65^{\circ}-25^{\circ}}{2} \\ & =2 \sin 45^{\circ} \cos 20^{\circ} \\ & =2 \times \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}} \times \cos 20^{\circ} \\ & =\sqrt{2} \cos 20^{\circ} \text { (Ans.) }\end{aligned}$

questions.question: দৃশ্যকল্প-I হতে b এবং c এর মান নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer:
