questions.question: দৃশ্যকল্প-II হতে দেখাও যে, $\mathrm{p}=\sqrt{3}$.
questions.answer:
চিত্রানুসারে, $ \theta+\alpha+80^{\circ}=180^{\circ} $

বা, $ 20^{\circ}+\alpha+80^{\circ}=180^{\circ} $

$ \therefore \alpha=80^{\circ} $

বামপক্ষ $=\mathrm{p} $

$ =\tan \theta \tan 2 \theta \tan \alpha $

$=\tan 20^{\circ} \tan 40^{\circ} \tan 80^{\circ} $

$ =\tan 20^{\circ} \tan \left(60^{\circ}-20^{\circ}\right) \tan \left(60^{\circ}+20^{\circ}\right) $

$ =\tan 20^{\circ} \cdot \frac{\tan 60^{\circ}-\tan 20^{\circ}}{1+\tan 60^{\circ} \cdot \tan 20^{\circ}} \cdot \frac{\tan 60^{\circ}+\tan 20^{\circ}}{1-\tan 60^{\circ} \cdot \tan 20^{\circ}} $

$ =\tan 20^{\circ} \cdot \frac{\sqrt{3}-\tan 20^{\circ}}{1+\sqrt{3} \tan 20^{\circ}} \cdot \frac{\sqrt{3}+\tan 20^{\circ}}{1-\sqrt{3} \tan 20^{\circ}} $

$ =\tan 20^{\circ} \cdot \frac{(\sqrt{3})^2-\tan ^2 20^{\circ}}{1-\left(\sqrt{3} \tan 20^{\circ}\right)^2} $

$ =\tan 20^{\circ} \cdot \frac{3-\tan ^2 20^{\circ}}{1-3 \tan ^2 20^{\circ}} $

$ =\frac{3 \tan 20^{\circ}-\tan ^3 20^{\circ}}{1-3 \tan ^2 20^{\circ}} $

$=\tan \left(3.20^{\circ}\right) $

$ =\tan 60^{\circ}=\sqrt{3} $

= ডানপক্ষ

$ \therefore \mathrm{p}=\sqrt{3} $ (দেখানো হলো)

questions.question: প্রমাণ কর যে, $\cos 2 \mathrm{p}=\frac{1-\tan ^2 \mathrm{p}}{1+\tan ^2 \mathrm{p}}$
questions.answer:
বামপক্ষ $=\cos 2 p=\cos ^2 \mathrm{p}-\sin ^2 \mathrm{p} $

 

$=\cos ^2 \mathrm{p}\left(1-\frac{\sin ^2 \mathrm{p}}{\cos ^2 \mathrm{p}}\right)=\frac{1}{\sec ^2 \mathrm{p}}\left(1-\tan ^2 \mathrm{p}\right) $

 

$ =\frac{1-\tan ^2 \mathrm{p}}{1+\tan ^2 \mathrm{p}}=$ ডানপক্ষ 

 

$ \therefore \cos 2 \mathrm{p}=\frac{1-\tan ^2 \mathrm{p}}{1+\tan ^2 \mathrm{p}} $ (প্রমাণিত)

questions.question: উদ্দীপকের আলোকে, প্রমাণ কর যে, $16 \cos \mathrm{A} \cos 2 \mathrm{~A} \cos 4 \mathrm{~A} \cos 7 \mathrm{~A}=1$
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $ \mathrm{A}=\frac{2 \pi}{15} $

 

বামপক্ষ $=16 \cos \mathrm{A} \cos 2 \mathrm{~A} \cos 4 \mathrm{~A} \cos 7 \mathrm{~A} $

 

$=\frac{8}{\sin \mathrm{A}}(2 \sin \mathrm{A} \cos \mathrm{A}) \cos 2 \mathrm{~A} \cos 4 \mathrm{~A} \cos 7 \mathrm{~A} $

 

$ =\frac{4}{\sin \mathrm{A}}(2 \sin 2 \mathrm{~A} \cos 2 \mathrm{~A}) \cos 4 \mathrm{~A} \cos 7 \mathrm{~A} $

 

$=\frac{2}{\sin \mathrm{A}}(2 \sin 4 \mathrm{~A} \cos 4 \mathrm{~A}) \cos 7 \mathrm{~A} $

 

$ =\frac{1}{\sin \mathrm{A}}(2 \sin 8 \mathrm{~A} \cos 7 \mathrm{~A})=\frac{1}{\sin \mathrm{A}}(\sin 15 \mathrm{~A}+\sin \mathrm{A}) $

 

$=\frac{1}{\sin \mathrm{A}}(\sin 2 \pi+\sin \mathrm{A}) \quad[\because 2 \pi=15 \mathrm{~A}] $

 

$=\frac{1}{\sin \mathrm{A}}(0+\sin \mathrm{A})=1=$ ডানপক্ষ 

 

$ \therefore 16 \cos \mathrm{A} \cos 2 \mathrm{~A} \cos 4 \mathrm{~A} \cos 7 \mathrm{~A}=1 $ (প্রমাণিত)

questions.question: উদ্দীপক থেকে দেখাও যে, $\tan \alpha=\tan \beta+\tan \gamma$
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $ \alpha+\beta+\gamma=\pi $ বা, $ \beta+\gamma=\pi-\alpha $

 

এবং $ \cos \alpha=\cos \beta \cos \gamma $

 

ডানপক্ষ $=\tan \beta+\tan \gamma=\frac{\sin \beta}{\cos \beta}+\frac{\sin \gamma}{\cos \gamma} $

 

$ =\frac{\sin \beta \cos \gamma+\cos \beta \sin \gamma}{\cos \beta \cos \gamma}=\frac{\sin (\beta+\gamma)}{\cos \alpha} $

 

$=\frac{\sin (\pi-\alpha)}{\cos \alpha}=\frac{\sin \alpha}{\cos \alpha}=\tan \alpha=$ বামপক্ষ 

 

$ \therefore \tan \alpha=\tan \beta+\tan \gamma $ (দেখানো হলো)

questions.question: যদি $\triangle \mathrm{PQR}$ এর তিনটি বাহুর দৈর্ঘ্য যথাক্রমে $\mathrm{p}, \mathrm{q}, \mathrm{r}$ এবং $\mathrm{p}^2+\mathrm{q}^2-\mathrm{r}^2=\sqrt{2} \mathrm{pq}$ হয়, তবে $\mathrm{R}$ কোণের মান নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $\mathrm{p}^2+\mathrm{q}^2-\mathrm{r}^2=\sqrt{2} \mathrm{pq}$


বা, $\frac{\mathrm{p}^2+\mathrm{q}^2-\mathrm{r}^2}{2 \mathrm{pq}}=\frac{\sqrt{2} \mathrm{pq}}{2 \mathrm{pq}}$


বা, $\cos R=\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}$


বা, $\cos \mathrm{R}=\cos 45^{\circ}$


$\therefore \mathrm{R}=45^{\circ}$ (Ans.)

questions.question: দৃশ্যকল্প : ১ এর আলোকে $\cos (\mathrm{x}+\mathrm{y})$ এর মান নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $\sin x+\sin y=a$


বা, $2 \sin \frac{x+y}{2} \cos \frac{x-y}{2}=\mathrm{a}$ ..... (i)


এবং $\cos \mathrm{x}+\cos \mathrm{y}=\mathrm{b}$


বা, $2 \cos \frac{x+y}{2} \cos \frac{x-y}{2}=b$ ...... (ii)


(i) $\div$ (ii) করে পাই, $\tan \frac{x+y}{2}=\frac{a}{b}$


বা, $\tan ^2 \frac{x+y}{2}=\frac{a^2}{b^2}$ বা, $\sec ^2 \frac{x+y}{2}-1=\frac{a^2}{b^2}$


বা, $\sec ^2 \frac{x+y}{2}=1+\frac{a^2}{b^2}$ বা, $\sec ^2 \frac{x+y}{2}=\frac{a^2+b^2}{b^2}$


বা, $\cos ^2 \frac{x+y}{2}=\frac{b^2}{a^2+b^2}$

 

বা, $2 \cos ^2 \frac{\mathrm{x}+\mathrm{y}}{2}=\frac{2 \mathrm{~b}^2}{\mathrm{a}^2+\mathrm{b}^2}$


বা, $1+\cos (x+y)=\frac{2 b^2}{a^2+b^2}$


বা, $\cos (\mathrm{x}+\mathrm{y})=\frac{2 \mathrm{~b}^2}{\mathrm{a}^2+\mathrm{b}^2}-1=\frac{2 \mathrm{~b}^2-\mathrm{a}^2-\mathrm{b}^2}{\mathrm{a}^2+\mathrm{b}^2}$


$\therefore \cos (\mathrm{x}+\mathrm{y})=\frac{\mathrm{b}^2-\mathrm{a}^2}{\mathrm{~b}^2+\mathrm{a}^2}$ (Ans.)

questions.question:
দৃশ্যকল্প : ২ হতে প্রমাণ কর যে, 
$ \sin ^2 \mathrm{~A}-\sin ^2 \mathrm{~B}+\sin ^2 \mathrm{C}=2 \sin \mathrm{A} \cos \mathrm{B} \sin \mathrm{C} $
questions.answer:
এখানে, $\triangle \mathrm{ABC} \Omega, \mathrm{A}+\mathrm{B}+\mathrm{C}=\pi$


বামপক্ষ $=\sin ^2 \mathrm{~A}-\sin ^2 \mathrm{~B}+\sin ^2 \mathrm{C} $


$ =(\sin A+\sin B)(\sin A-\sin B)+\sin ^2 C $


$ =\left(2 \sin \frac{A+B}{2} \cos \frac{A-B}{2}\right) \cdot\left(2 \cos \frac{A+B}{2} \sin \frac{A-B}{2}\right)+\sin ^2 C $


$ =\left(2 \sin \frac{A+B}{2} \cos \frac{A+B}{2}\right) \cdot\left(2 \sin \frac{A-B}{2} \cos \frac{A-B}{2}\right)+\sin ^2 C $


$ =\sin (A+B) \sin (A-B)+\sin ^2 C $


$ =\sin (\pi-C) \sin (A-B)+\sin ^2 C[\because A+B+C=\pi] $


$ =\sin C \sin (A-B)+\sin ^2 C $


$ =\sin C\{\sin (A-B)+\sin C\} $


$ =\sin C[\sin (A-B)+\sin \{\pi-(A+B)\}][\because A+B+C=\pi] $


$ =\sin C\{\sin (A-B)+\sin (A+B)\} $


$ =\sin \mathrm{C} \cdot 2 \sin \mathrm{A} \cos \mathrm{B} $


$ =2 \sin \mathrm{A} \cos \mathrm{B} \sin \mathrm{C}=$ ডানপক্ষ


$ \therefore \sin ^2 \mathrm{~A}-\sin ^2 \mathrm{~B}+\sin ^2 \mathrm{C}=2 \sin \mathrm{A} \cos \mathrm{B} \sin \mathrm{C} $ (প্রমাণিত)

questions.question: প্রমাণ কর যে, $\tan 75^{\circ}=2+\sqrt{3}$.
questions.answer:
$ \tan 75^{\circ}=\tan \left(45^{\circ}+30^{\circ}\right)=\frac{\tan 45^{\circ}+\tan 30^{\circ}}{1-\tan 45^{\circ} \tan 30^{\circ}} $

 

$=\frac{1+\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}}{1-\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}}=\frac{\frac{\sqrt{3}+1}{\sqrt{3}}}{\frac{\sqrt{3}-1}{\sqrt{3}}}=\frac{\sqrt{3}+1}{\sqrt{3}-1} $

 

$ =\frac{(\sqrt{3}+1)(\sqrt{3}+1)}{(\sqrt{3}-1)(\sqrt{3}+1)}=\frac{3+\sqrt{3}+\sqrt{3}+1}{(\sqrt{3})^2-1^2} $

 

$=\frac{4+2 \sqrt{3}}{3-1}=\frac{2(2+\sqrt{3})}{2} $

 

$ \therefore \tan 75^{\circ}=2+\sqrt{3} $ (প্রমাণিত)

questions.question: দৃশ্যকল্প-১ এর আলোকে দেখাও যে, ত্রিভুজটি সমকোণী।
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $\cos X=\sin Y-\cos Z$


বা, $\cos X+\cos Z=\sin Y$


বা, $\cos \mathrm{X}+\cos \{\pi-(\mathrm{X}+\mathrm{Y})\}=\sin \mathrm{Y}[\because \mathrm{X}+\mathrm{Y}+\mathrm{Z}=\pi]$


বা, $\cos X-\cos (X+Y)=\sin Y$


বা, $2 \sin \frac{2 X+Y}{2} \sin \frac{Y}{2}=2 \sin \frac{Y}{2} \cos \frac{Y}{2}$


বা, $\sin \left(X+\frac{Y}{2}\right)=\cos \frac{Y}{2}=\sin \left(\frac{\pi}{2}-\frac{Y}{2}\right)$


$\therefore \quad X+\frac{Y}{2}=\frac{\pi}{2}-\frac{Y}{2}$


বা, $X+Y=\frac{\pi}{2}$


$\therefore \quad \mathrm{Z}=\frac{\pi}{2}$


অর্থাৎ $\triangle X Y Z$ সমকোণী। (দেখানো হলো)

questions.question: দৃশ্যকল্প-২ এর আলোকে দেখাও যে, $\cos \beta=\frac{\cos \alpha-\mathrm{n}}{1-\mathrm{n} \cos \alpha}$
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $\sqrt{1+\mathrm{n}} \tan \frac{\alpha}{2}=\sqrt{1-\mathrm{n}} \cdot \tan \frac{\beta}{2}$


বা, $\tan \frac{\alpha}{2}=\sqrt{\frac{1-n}{1+n}} \tan \frac{\beta}{2}$


বা, $\tan ^2 \frac{\alpha}{2}=\frac{1-n}{1+n} \tan ^2 \frac{\beta}{2}$


বা, $\tan ^2 \frac{\beta}{2}=\frac{1+\mathrm{n}}{1-\mathrm{n}} \tan ^2 \frac{\alpha}{2}$


বা, $\frac{\sin ^2 \frac{\beta}{2}}{\cos ^2 \frac{\beta}{2}}=\frac{(1+\mathrm{n}) \sin ^2 \frac{\alpha}{2}}{(1-\mathrm{n}) \cos ^2 \frac{\alpha}{2}}$


বা, $\frac{\cos ^2 \frac{\beta}{2}}{\sin ^2 \frac{\beta}{2}}=\frac{(1-n) \cos ^2 \frac{\alpha}{2}}{(1+n) \sin ^2 \frac{\alpha}{2}}$ या, $\frac{\cos ^2 \frac{\beta}{2}-\sin ^2 \frac{\beta}{2}}{\cos ^2 \frac{\beta}{2}+\sin ^2 \frac{\beta}{2}}=\frac{(1-n) \cos ^2 \frac{\alpha}{2}-(1+n) \sin ^2 \frac{\alpha}{2}}{(1-n) \cos ^2 \frac{\alpha}{2}+(1+n) \sin ^2 \frac{\alpha}{2}}$


[বিয়োজন-যোজন করে]

বা, $\frac{\cos \beta}{1}=\frac{\left(\cos ^2 \frac{\alpha}{2}-\sin ^2 \frac{\alpha}{2}\right)-n\left(\cos ^2 \frac{\alpha}{2}+\sin ^2 \frac{\alpha}{2}\right)}{\left(\cos ^2 \frac{\alpha}{2}+\sin ^2 \frac{\alpha}{2}\right)-n\left(\cos ^2 \frac{\alpha}{2}-\sin ^2 \frac{\alpha}{2}\right)}$


$\therefore \cos \beta=\frac{\cos \alpha-n}{1-n \cos \alpha}$ (দেখানো হলো)

questions.question: $\tan \beta=\frac{1}{3}$ হলে, $\sin 2 \beta$ এর মান নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $\tan \beta=\frac{1}{3}$


$ \therefore \sin 2 \beta=\frac{2 \tan \beta}{1+\tan ^2 \beta}=\frac{2 \times \frac{1}{3}}{1+\left(\frac{1}{3}\right)^2}=\frac{2}{3} \times \frac{9}{10}=\frac{3}{5} \text { (Ans.) } $

questions.question: দেখাও যে, $2 \sin \left(\pi+\frac{F}{4}\right)=-\sqrt{2-\sqrt{2+\sqrt{2}}}$.
questions.answer:
$ \angle \mathrm{E}+\angle \mathrm{F}=65^{\circ} \ldots \ldots \text { (i) } $


$ \angle \mathrm{F}-\angle \mathrm{E}=25^{\circ} \ldots \ldots \text { (ii) } $

(i) ও (ii) নং যোগ করে পাই, $2 \angle \mathrm{F}=90^{\circ} \therefore \angle \mathrm{F}=45^{\circ}$

বামপক্ষ $=2 \sin \left(\pi+\frac{F}{4}\right)=-2 \sin \frac{F}{4}=-2 \sin \frac{45^{\circ}}{4} $


$ =-\sqrt{4 \sin ^2 \frac{45^{\circ}}{4}}=-\sqrt{2.2 \sin ^2 \frac{45^{\circ}}{4}}=-\sqrt{2\left(1-\cos 2 . \frac{45^{\circ}}{4}\right)} $


$ =-\sqrt{2-2 \cos \frac{45^{\circ}}{2}}=-\sqrt{2-\sqrt{4 \cos ^2 \frac{45^{\circ}}{2}}} $


$ =-\sqrt{2-\sqrt{2.2 \cos ^2 \frac{45^{\circ}}{2}}}=-\sqrt{2-\sqrt{2\left(1+\cos 2 . \frac{45^{\circ}}{2}\right)}} $


$ =-\sqrt{2-\sqrt{2+2 \cdot \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}}}=-\sqrt{2-\sqrt{2+\sqrt{2}}}=$ ডানপক্ষ


$ \therefore 2 \sin \left(\pi+\frac{F}{4}\right)=-\sqrt{2-\sqrt{2+\sqrt{2}}} $ (দেখানো হলো)

questions.question: দেখাও যে, $\tan \angle \mathrm{E} \cdot \tan 2 \angle \mathrm{E} \cdot \tan 3 \angle \mathrm{E} \cdot \tan 4 \angle \mathrm{E}=3$.
questions.answer:
$ \angle \mathrm{E} =65^{\circ}-\angle \mathrm{F}=65^{\circ}-45^{\circ}=20^{\circ} $


বামপক্ষ $ =\tan \angle \mathrm{E} \tan 2 \angle \mathrm{E} \tan 3 \angle \mathrm{E} \tan 4 \angle \mathrm{E} $


$ =\tan 20^{\circ} \tan 40^{\circ} \tan 60^{\circ} \tan 80^{\circ} $


$ =\sqrt{3} \tan 20^{\circ} \tan 40^{\circ} \tan 80^{\circ} $


$ =\sqrt{3} \tan 20^{\circ} \tan \left(60^{\circ}-20^{\circ}\right) \tan \left(60^{\circ}+20^{\circ}\right) $


$ =\sqrt{3} \tan 20^{\circ} \cdot \frac{\tan 60^{\circ}-\tan 20^{\circ}}{1+\tan 60^{\circ} \cdot \tan 20^{\circ}} \cdot \frac{\tan 60^{\circ}+\tan 20^{\circ}}{1-\tan 60^{\circ} \cdot \tan 20^{\circ}} $


$ =\sqrt{3} \tan 20^{\circ} \cdot \frac{\sqrt{3}-\tan 20^{\circ}}{1+\sqrt{3} \tan 20^{\circ}} \cdot \frac{\sqrt{3}+\tan 20^{\circ}}{1-\sqrt{3} \tan 20^{\circ}}$


$ =\sqrt{3} \tan 20^{\circ} \cdot \frac{(\sqrt{3})^2-\tan 20^{\circ}}{1-\left(\sqrt{3} \tan 20^{\circ}\right)^2} $


$ =\sqrt{3} \tan 20^{\circ} \cdot \frac{3-\tan ^2 20^{\circ}}{1-3 \tan ^2 20^{\circ}} $


$ =\sqrt{3} \times \frac{3 \tan 20^{\circ}-\tan ^3 20^{\circ}}{1-3 \tan ^2 20^{\circ}} $


$ =\sqrt{3} \tan \left(3 \cdot 20^{\circ}\right)=\sqrt{3} \tan _4 0^{\circ} $


$ =\sqrt{3} \times \sqrt{3}=3=5 \operatorname{la}^{\circ} $



$\therefore \tan \angle \mathrm{E} \cdot \tan 2 \angle \mathrm{E} \cdot \tan 3 \angle \mathrm{E} \cdot \tan 4 \angle \mathrm{E}=3$ (দেখানো হলো)

questions.question: $\frac{\cos 75^{\circ}+\cos 15^{\circ}}{\cos 75^{\circ}-\cos 15^{\circ}}$ এর মান নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer: $\begin{aligned} & \frac{\cos 75^{\circ}+\cos 15^{\circ}}{\cos 75^{\circ}-\cos 15^{\circ}} \\ & =\frac{2 \cos \frac{75^{\circ}+15^{\circ}}{2} \cos \frac{75^{\circ}-15^{\circ}}{2}}{2 \sin \frac{75^{\circ}+15^{\circ}}{2} \sin \frac{15^{\circ}-75^{\circ}}{2}} \\ & =\frac{\cos 45^{\circ} \cos 30^{\circ}}{\sin 45^{\circ} \sin \left(-30^{\circ}\right)}=\cot 45^{\circ}\left(-\cot 30^{\circ}\right) \\ & =1 \times(-\sqrt{3})=-\sqrt{3} \text { (Ans.) } \\ & \end{aligned}$

questions.question: $\operatorname{secB}=\sec C \sec \mathrm{A}$ হলে দেখাও যে, $\tan \mathrm{A}=2 \cot C$.
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, secB = secC secA

 

বা, $ \frac{1}{\cos \mathrm{B}}=\frac{1}{\cos \mathrm{C}} \cdot \frac{1}{\cos \mathrm{A}} $

 

$ \therefore \cos \mathrm{B}=\cos \mathrm{A} \cos \mathrm{C} $

 

আমরা জানি, $ \mathrm{A}+\mathrm{B}+\mathrm{C}=\pi $

 

বা, $ \mathrm{B}=\pi-(\mathrm{A}+\mathrm{C}) $

 

বা, $ \cos \mathrm{B}=\cos \{\pi-(\mathrm{A}+\mathrm{C})\} $

 

বা, $ \cos \mathrm{B}=-\cos (\mathrm{A}+\mathrm{C}) $

 

বা, $ \cos \mathrm{A} \cos \mathrm{C}=-(\cos \mathrm{A} \cos \mathrm{C}-\sin \mathrm{A} \sin \mathrm{C}) $

 

বা, $ 2 \cos \mathrm{A} \cos \mathrm{C}=\sin \mathrm{A} \sin \mathrm{C} $

 

বা, $ \frac{2 \cos \mathrm{C}}{\sin \mathrm{C}}=\frac{\sin \mathrm{A}}{\cos \mathrm{A}} $

 

$ \therefore \tan \mathrm{A}=2 \cot \mathrm{C} $ (দেখানো হলো)

questions.question: দৃশ্যকল্পের আলোকে $4 \mathrm{~s}(\mathrm{~s}-\mathrm{b})=3 \mathrm{ca}$ হলে, $\angle \mathrm{B}$ এর মান কত?
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $4 \mathrm{~s}(\mathrm{~s}-\mathrm{b})=3 \mathrm{ca}$


বা, $\frac{\mathrm{s}(\mathrm{s}-\mathrm{b})}{\mathrm{ca}}=\frac{3}{4}$


বা, $\cos ^2 \frac{\mathrm{B}}{2}=\frac{3}{4}$


বা, $\cos \frac{B}{2}=\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}=\cos 30^{\circ}$

questions.question: $\triangle \mathrm{ABC}$ এর ক্ষেত্রে প্রমাণ কর যে, $\mathrm{a}^2+\mathrm{b}^2+\mathrm{c}^2=8 \mathrm{R}^2(1+\cos \mathrm{A} \cos \mathrm{B} \cos \mathrm{C})$.
questions.answer:
$ \mathrm{a}^2+\mathrm{b}^2+\mathrm{c}^2 $

 

$=(2 \mathrm{R} \sin \mathrm{A})^2+(2 \mathrm{R} \sin \mathrm{B})^2+(2 \mathrm{R} \sin \mathrm{C})^2 $

 

$=4 \mathrm{R}^2\left(\sin ^2 \mathrm{~A}+\sin ^2 \mathrm{~B}+\sin ^2 \mathrm{C}\right) $

 

এখন, $ \sin ^2 \mathrm{~A}+\sin ^2 \mathrm{~B}+\sin ^2 \mathrm{C} $

 

$=\frac{1}{2}\left(2 \sin ^2 \mathrm{~A}+2 \sin ^2 \mathrm{~B}\right)+\sin ^2 \mathrm{C} $

 

$ =\frac{1}{2}(1-\cos 2 \mathrm{~A}+1-\cos 2 \mathrm{~B})+\sin ^2 \mathrm{C} $

 

$ =\frac{1}{2}(2-\cos 2 \mathrm{~A}-\cos 2 \mathrm{~B})+\sin ^2 \mathrm{C} $

 

$ =1-\frac{1}{2}(\cos 2 \mathrm{~A}+\cos 2 \mathrm{~B})+\sin ^2 \mathrm{C} $

 

$=1-\frac{1}{2} \cdot 2 \cos (\mathrm{A}+\mathrm{B}) \cos (\mathrm{A}-\mathrm{B})+1-\cos ^2 \mathrm{C} $

 

$ =2-\cos (\pi-\mathrm{C}) \cos (\mathrm{A}-\mathrm{B})-\cos ^2 \mathrm{C} $

 

$=2+\cos \mathrm{C} \cos (\mathrm{A}-\mathrm{B})-\cos \mathrm{C} $

 

$ =2+\cos \mathrm{C}[\cos (\mathrm{A}-\mathrm{B})-\cos \mathrm{C}] $

 

$=2+\cos \mathrm{C}[\cos (\mathrm{A}-\mathrm{B})+\cos (\mathrm{A}+\mathrm{B})][\because \mathrm{A}+\mathrm{B}+\mathrm{C}=\pi] $

 

$ =2+\cos \mathrm{C} \cdot 2 \cdot \cos \mathrm{A} \cdot \cos \mathrm{B} $

 

$=2+2 \cos \mathrm{A} \cos \mathrm{B} \cos \mathrm{C} $

 

$ \therefore \mathrm{a}^2+\mathrm{b}^2+\mathrm{c}^2=4 \mathrm{R}^2(2+2 \cos \mathrm{A} \cos \mathrm{B} \cos \mathrm{C}) $

 

$ \therefore \mathrm{a}^2+\mathrm{b}^2+\mathrm{c}^2=8 \mathrm{R}^2(1+\cos \mathrm{A} \cos \mathrm{B} \cos \mathrm{C}) $ প্রাণিত)

questions.question: $\cos \theta=\frac{3}{\sqrt{13}}$ হলে, $\sqrt{\frac{2-\cot ^2 \theta}{2+\cot ^2 \theta}}$ এর মান নির্ণয় কর।

$=\sqrt{\frac{-1}{4} \times \frac{4}{17}}=\sqrt{\frac{-1}{17}} \text { (Ans.) } $

questions.question: $f(x)+f(y)=p$ এবং $g(x)+g(y)=q$ হলে প্রমাণ কর যে, $\mathrm{f}\left(\frac{\mathrm{x}-\mathrm{y}}{2}\right)= \pm \frac{1}{2} \sqrt{4-\mathrm{p}^2-\mathrm{q}^2}$
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $\mathrm{f}(\mathrm{x})+\mathrm{f}(\mathrm{y})=\mathrm{p}$


$ \therefore \sin x+\sin y=p \ldots \ldots \ldots (i) $


এবং $ g(x)+g(y)=q $


$ \therefore \cos x+\cos y=q \ldots \ldots \ldots (ii)$


এখানে, $ \sin x+\sin y=p $


$ \therefore 2 \sin \frac{x+y}{2} \cos \frac{x-y}{2}=p . $


$ \therefore \cos x+\cos y=q \ldots \ldots \ldots (iii) $


এবং $\cos x+\cos y=q$


$ \therefore 2 \cos \frac{\mathrm{x}+\mathrm{y}}{2} \cos \frac{\mathrm{x}-\mathrm{y}}{2}=\mathrm{q} ...... (iv) $

 

এখন, (iii) নং ও (iv) নং কে বর্গ করে যোগ করে পাই,


$ 4 \cos ^2\left(\frac{x-y}{2}\right) \sin ^2 \left(\frac{x+y}{2}\right) $


$ +4 \cos ^2\left(\frac{x-y}{2}\right) \cos ^2\left(\frac{x+y}{2}\right)=p^2+q^2 $


বা, $4 \cos ^2\left(\frac{\mathrm{x}-\mathrm{y}}{2}\right)\left\{\sin ^2\left(\frac{\mathrm{x}+\mathrm{y}}{2}\right)+\cos ^2\left(\frac{\mathrm{x}+\mathrm{y}}{2}\right)\right\}=\mathrm{p}^2+\mathrm{q}^2$


বা, $4 \cos ^2\left(\frac{x-y}{2}\right)=p^2+q^2$


বা, $4\left\{1-\sin ^2\left(\frac{x-y}{2}\right)\right\}=p^2+q^2$


বা, $4 \sin ^2\left(\frac{\mathrm{x}-\mathrm{y}}{2}\right)=4-\mathrm{p}^2-\mathrm{q}^2$


বা, $\sin ^2\left(\frac{\mathrm{x}-\mathrm{y}}{2}\right)=\frac{1}{4}\left(4-\mathrm{p}^2-\mathrm{q}^2\right)$


বা, $\sin \frac{1}{2}(x-y)= \pm \frac{1}{2} \sqrt{4-p^2-q^2}$


$\therefore \mathrm{f}\left(\frac{\mathrm{x}-\mathrm{y}}{2}\right)= \pm \frac{1}{2} \sqrt{4-\mathrm{p}^2-\mathrm{q}^2}$ (প্রমাণিত)

questions.question: $-\frac{\pi}{2} \leq x \leq \pi$ ব্যবধিতে $f(2 x)$ এর লেখচিত্র অঙ্কন করে এর একটি বৈশিষ্ট্য লিখ।
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $f(x)=\sin x$


$ \therefore \mathrm{f}(2 \mathrm{x})=\sin 2 \mathrm{x} ;-\frac{\pi}{2} \leq \mathrm{x} \leq \pi $

 

প্রদত্ত ফাংশনটি সাইন ফাংশন। প্রদত্ত রেডিয়ান মানকে ডিগ্রীতে রুপান্তর করে সাইন সারণি হতে $x=-\frac{\pi}{2}$ বা $-90^{\circ}$ হতে $x=\pi$ বা $180^{\circ}$ পর্যন্ত $15^{\circ}$ ব্যবধানে $\sin 2 \mathrm{x}$ এর মান নেওয়া হয়েছে। $\mathrm{x}$ এর মানের প্রতিসঙ্গী y এর মানগুলি ছকে স্থাপন করা হয়েছে।

স্কেল নির্ধারণ : $x$ অক্ষ বরাবর ছোট বর্গের এক বাহু $=5^{\circ}$ এবং y-অক্ষ বরাবর ছোট বর্গের 1 বাহু = 0.1 একক। এখন নির্ধারিত স্কেলে বিন্দুগুলি (ছক হতে প্রাপ্ত) গ্রাফ কাগজে বসিয়ে সুযমভাবে যোগ করে $\sin 2 x$ এর লেখচিত্র অঙ্কন করি।

বৈশিষ্ট্য: লেখচিত্রটি অবিচ্ছিন্ন, ঢেউয়ের মত এবং মূলবিন্দুগামী, $\mathrm{y}=\sin 2 \mathrm{x}$ একটি পর্যায়বৃত্ত ফাংশন যার পর্যায়কাল $\pi$.

questions.question: প্রমাণ কর যে, $\sec \frac{3 x}{2}=\frac{2 \sqrt{2}}{\sqrt{4+\sqrt{8+8 \cos 6 x}}}$.

questions.question: যদি $p+q=c, r+s=d$ হয় তবে দেখাও যে, $\cos (2 \alpha+2 \beta)=\frac{d^{2}-c^{2}}{d^{2}+c^{2}}$.
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $p=\sin 2 \alpha, q=\sin 2 \beta, r=\cos 2 \alpha, s=\cos 2 \beta$


$p+q=c$


$\therefore \sin 2 \alpha+\sin 2 \beta=c .......... (1) $


এবং $\mathrm{r}+\mathrm{s}=\mathrm{d}$


$\therefore \cos 2 \alpha+\cos 2 \beta=d ........ (2) $


(2) নং কে (1) নং দ্বারা ভাগ করে পাই,


$\frac{\cos 2 \alpha+\cos 2 \beta}{\sin 2 \alpha+\sin 2 \beta}=\frac{d}{c}$


বা, $\frac{2 \cos \frac{2 \alpha+2 \beta}{2} \cos \frac{2 \alpha-2 \beta}{2}}{2 \sin \frac{2 \alpha+2 \beta}{2} \cos \frac{2 \alpha-2 \beta}{2}}=\frac{d}{c}$


বা, $\frac{\cos (\alpha+\beta)}{\sin (\alpha+\beta)}=\frac{d}{c}$


বা, $\frac{\cos ^{2}(\alpha+\beta)}{\sin ^{2}(\alpha+\beta)}=\frac{\mathrm{d}^{2}}{\mathrm{e}^{2}}$ [বর্গ করি]


বা, $\frac{\cos ^{2}(\alpha+\beta)+\sin ^{2}(\alpha+\beta)}{\cos ^{2}(\alpha+\beta)-\sin ^{2}(\alpha+\beta)}=\frac{d^{2}+c^{2}}{d^{2}-c^{2}}$ [যোজন বিয়োজন করে]


বা, $\frac{1}{\cos 2(\alpha+\beta)}=\frac{d^{2}+c^{2}}{d^{2}-c^{2}}$


বা, $\frac{1}{\cos (2 \alpha+2 \beta)}=\frac{d^{2}+c^{2}}{d^{2}-c^{2}}$


$\therefore \cos (2 \alpha+2 \beta)=\frac{\mathrm{d}^{2}-c^{2}}{\mathrm{~d}^{2}+\mathrm{c}^{2}}$. (দেখানো হলো)

questions.question: যদি $\alpha+\beta+\gamma=\pi$ হয় তবে দেখাও যে, $p^{2}+q^{2}+t^{2}=2-2 \cos 2 \alpha \cos 2 \beta \cos 2 \gamma$.
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $p=\sin 2 \alpha$


$q=\sin 2 \beta$


$t=\sin 2 \gamma$


এবং $\alpha+\beta+\gamma=\pi$


বামপক $=\mathrm{p}^{2}+\mathrm{q}^{2}+\mathrm{t}^{2}$


$=\sin ^{2} 2 \alpha+\sin ^{2} 2 \beta+\sin ^{2} 2 \gamma$


$ =\frac{1}{2}\left(2 \sin ^{2} 2 \alpha+2 \sin ^{2} 2 \beta\right)+\sin ^{2} 2 \gamma $


$ =\frac{1}{2}(1-\cos 4 \alpha+1-\cos 4 \beta)+\sin ^{2} 2 \gamma $


$ =1-\frac{1}{2}(\cos 4 \alpha+\cos 4 \beta)+\sin ^{2} 2 \gamma $


$ =1-\frac{1}{2} \cdot 2 \cos \frac{4 \alpha+4 \beta}{2} \cos \frac{4 \alpha-4 \beta}{2}+\sin ^{2} 2 \gamma $


$ =1-\cos (2 \alpha+2 \beta) \cos (2 \alpha-2 \beta)+\sin ^{2} 2 \gamma $


$ =1-\cos (2 \pi-2 \gamma) \cos (2 \alpha-2 \beta)+1-\cos ^{2} 2 \gamma $


$ \quad \quad \quad [\because \alpha+\beta+\gamma=\pi $


$ \quad \therefore 2 \alpha+2 \beta=2 \pi-2 \gamma] $


$ =2-\cos 2 \gamma \cos (2 \alpha-2 \beta)-\cos 2 \gamma $


$ =2-\cos 2 \gamma\{\cos (2 \alpha-2 \beta)+\cos 2 \gamma\} $


$ =2-\cos 2 \gamma\{\cos (2 \alpha-2 \beta)+\cos (2 \pi-2 \alpha-2 \beta)\} $


$ =2-\cos 2 \gamma\{\cos (2 \alpha-2 \beta)+\cos (2 \alpha+2 \beta)\} $


$ =2-\cos 2 \gamma \cdot 2 \cos 2 \alpha \cos 2 \beta $


$ =2-2 \cos 2 \alpha \cos 2 \beta \cos 2 \gamma=$ ডানপক্ষ


$ \therefore \mathrm{p}^{2}+\mathrm{q}^{2}+\mathrm{t}^{2}=2-2 \cos 2 \alpha \cos 2 \beta \cos 2 \gamma . $ (দেখানো হলো)
